title: Vil du uddanne fremtidens sygeplejersker?
description:
Vil du bidrage til fremtidens sundhedssektor? Kan du facilitere læringsforløb, og er du optaget af at skabe læringsmiljøer, der fastholder de studerendes engagement og faglige nysgerrighed? Kan du se dig selv undervise på efter- og videreuddannelsesaktiviteter og bidrage til forskning og udvikling? Så har vi lige nu en spændende stilling på sygeplejerskeuddannelsen i Slagelse.

På Professionshøjskolen Absalon er det vores ambition at levere engagerende undervisning på et højt fagligt niveau. Det er en del af vores uddannelsesløfte til de studerende, at vi skal facilitere undervisning af høj kvalitet og samtidig skabe læring og motivation. Du bliver en del af en uddannelses - og arbejdskultur, hvor vi sætter de studerende først, værdsætter fællesskab og faglighed, og hvor uddannelsesprofessionalismen er tydelig i alt, hvad vi gør.

Din profil
Vi søger en underviser med særlig interesse for simulation, klinisk beslutningstagen og sygepleje i akutte og komplekse patientforløb. Du er optaget af at skabe praksisnære læringsforløb, hvor sygeplejestuderende udvikler klinisk blik, prioriteringsevne og handlekompetence i akutte pleje- og behandlingssituationer.

Du kan omsætte sygeplejefaglig og klinisk viden til undervisning, der understøtter de studerendes evne til at observere, vurdere, kommunikere og træffe kliniske beslutninger i samspil med patienter, pårørende og tværprofessionelle samarbejdspartnere.

Du ser simulation og færdighedstræning som centrale didaktiske greb i arbejdet med patientsikkerhed, klinisk ræsonnering og professionsfaglig udvikling.

Derudover kan du se dig selv i følgende:
Du er en dygtig facilitator af lærings- og udviklingsprocesser. Du har erfaring med at skabe inspirerende læringsmiljøer. Du har en innovativ tilgang og evner at differentiere undervisningen, så den matcher de studerendes forskellige forudsætninger.

Du mestrer klasserumsledelse og digitale læringsformer. Du er optaget af at bruge digitale og teknologiske løsninger - herunder simulation, digitale læringsplatforme og velfærdsteknologi - som en naturlig del af undervisningen.

Du har kompetencer inden for det natur- og sundhedsvidenskabelige område, og kan omsætte dine kliniske erfaringer til læringsmæssige sammenhænge.

Du arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret. Du trives i en kompleks hverdag, hvor du prioriterer og organiserer dine opgaver med overblik og fleksibilitet. Du er omstillingsparat og bevarer fokus - også når der er mange bolde i luften.

Du har mod og personlig gennemslagskraft. Du er tydelig i din kommunikation og har god selvindsigt samt trives i sociale sammenhænge. Du har forståelse for gruppedynamikker og ønsker at bidrage til et godt studie- og arbejdsmiljø.

Derudover forventer vi, at du har:
  • En sundhedsfaglig grunduddannelse
  • En relevant sundhedsvidenskabelig eller samfundsvidenskabelig uddannelsesbaggrund på master-, kandidat- og gerne også på ph.d.-niveau
  • It- og teknologikompetencer på avanceret brugerniveau, herunder erfaring med e-didaktik og anvendelse af teknologi til at understøtte flipped og blended learning

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som underviser hos os bliver du en del af et fagligt miljø, hvor opgaverne er fordelt på tre hovedområder: grunduddannelse, efter- og videreuddannelse samt forskning og udvikling. Du vil varetage opgaver på alle tre områder som en naturlig del af stillingen. Nogle eksempler på opgaver kunne være:

Undervisning, vejledning, feedback og eksamination på sygeplejerskeuddannelsen. Afhængigt af din profil vil du planlægge, gennemføre og evaluere undervisning i tæt samarbejde med erfarne kolleger og under supervision af uddannelsesleder. Undervisningen vil særligt omfatte natur- og sundhedsvidenskabelige fagområder som anatomi og fysiologi, sygdomslære og klinisk beslutningstagning med fokus er på at skabe sammenhæng mellem naturvidenskabelig viden, kliniske vurderinger og sygeplejefaglig praksis.

Efter- og videreuddannelse af sundhedsprofessionelle. Afhængigt af din profil, vil du komme til at indgå i underviserteams med erfarne kolleger, der arbejder med kompetencegivende forløb for sundhedsprofessionelle i region Sjælland - enten gennem den sundhedsfaglige diplomuddannelse eller rekvirerede forløb fra praksis.

Forskning og udvikling. Sammen med dygtige forskere vil du bidrage til centrets forsknings- og udviklingsaktiviteter, f.eks. ved at indgå i gennemførelsen projekter, bidrage til dataindsamling eller indgå i ansøgningsarbejde. Opgaverne løses under supervision med erfarne forskere.

Dine kolleger
På sygeplejerskeuddannelsens udbud i Slagelse bliver du kollega med ca. 25 dygtige og fagligt engagerede kolleger. Sammen bidrager vi til et miljø præget af godt humør og åbenhed. Vores daglige frokost udgør ofte et hyggeligt samlingspunkt, hvor vi deler idéer og oplevelser.

På sygeplejerskeuddannelsen er vi i alt ca. 86 medarbejdere fordelt på vores fem udbudssteder organiseret i team Roskilde/Holbæk, team Slagelse og team Næstved/Nykøbing. Alle medarbejdere løser opgaver inden for grunduddannelse, efter- og videreuddannelse samt forskning og udvikling, og vi lægger vægt på at videndele og løse opgaverne i fællesskab.

Vi er en del af Center for Sundhed som består af ergoterapeutuddannelsen, ernæring og sundhedsuddannelsen, fysioterapeutuddannelsen, jordemoderuddannelsen og den sundhedsadministrative koordinatoruddannelse. I centeret er vi tilsammen ca. 140 ansatte.

Sådan ansøger du
Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • Der er mulighed for både deltid og fuldtid gældende fra den 1. januar 2027.
  • For dig der er nyuddannet og ansættes som adjunkt, vil en forventet startløn være 36.822,43, - kr. inkl. pension. For dig der er en erfaren underviser og ansættes som lektor, vil en forventet startløn være 54.630,59 kr. inkl. pension.
  • Hvis du har nogle spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte uddannelsesleder Cecilie Betzer på tlf: 72 48 21 04
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger, eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 27. oktober 2026.
  • Vi forventer at afholde 1. samtale den 6. november 2026 og eventuel 2. samtale den 17. november 2026.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Alt efter dine kvalifikationer vil du blive ansat som adjunkt eller lektor

På Absalon er adjunkturet en 4-årig uddannelsesstilling. Det understøtter vi gennem Absalons lektorkvalificeringsforløb, som alle nyansatte adjunkter deltager i, og alle får tilknyttet en vejleder. For at blive ansat som lektor forudsætter det en positiv lektorbedømmelse inden for stillingstrukturens anvendelsesområde.

Ved ansættelse af lektorer der er lektorbedømt før 2013-stillingsstrukturen, sker ansættelse på hidtidige centralt fastsatte løn- og ansættelsesvilkår. Afhængig af dine kvalifikationer, afvejet med stillingens konkrete indhold, kan fornyet lektorbedømmelse efter den aktuelle stillingsstruktur (fast-track ordningen) eventuelt aftales. Læs mere her i kap. 5. https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2020/673

Du kan læse mere om rammerne for ansættelse som adjunkt eller lektor i vores stillingsstruktur her: https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2021/1458

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

title: snedker til reolreol
description:
Vi laver verdens måske smukkeste reoler. Vi har travlt, og vi vil gerne have dig med på holdet.

Vi søger en dygtig, venlig og effektiv snedker, der kan hjælpe med at producere og montere vores reoler – og gøre produktionen lidt bedre for hver eneste reol, vi bygger.

Vi genopfinder ikke den dybe tallerken hver dag. Til gengæld er der masser af mulighed for at nørde selv de mindste detaljer. Vi er hele tiden på jagt efter de små forbedringer, der gør reolreol en smule bedre.

Hvilken type snedker du er, er ikke det vigtigste. Vi arbejder meget digitalt og med CNC, men ikke i massivtræ. Elsker du systemer og værkstedsprocesser, er det her måske lige jobbet for dig.

reolreol er et hyggeligt lille firma med fem ansatte. Vi laver selv alt fra marketing og salg til produktion og montage. Vi har en stærk DIY-ånd og tror på, at vi selv kan udvikle løsningerne på de udfordringer, vi møder undervejs. Vi holder til i København SV, tæt på vandet og i et fællesskab med andre firmaer.

Dit arbejde foregår både på værkstedet og ude hos kunderne. Du skal være glad for at møde nye mennesker og tryg ved at tage ansvar for reolen og montagen – og måske også have lyst til at lave lidt indhold til sociale medier undervejs.

Du skal have kørekort. Det er dejligt, hvis du taler dansk, men det er ikke et krav.

Vi elsker folk, der kan noget ekstra. Måske har du en baggrund som grafisk designer eller fotograf. Måske kan du skrive kode, tegne i CAD eller noget helt andet. Det vil vi gerne høre om.

Er du nysgerrig? Så send os en kort ansøgning og dit CV.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Danfoods ApS søger 1 industriingeniør
description:
Danfoods ApS er en af Danmarks stærke totalleverandører inden for fødevarer og non-food. Vi har fem afdelinger i Herning, Odense, Aarhus, Aalborg og Ishøj.

Vi har vores egen fødevare- og kødproduktion med en omfattende maskinpark bestående af mange forskellige produktionsmaskiner og tekniske anlæg.

Vi søger derfor en dygtig og alsidig maskinmester / servicetekniker, der kan sikre, at vores maskiner og tekniske udstyr fungerer optimalt.

Arbejdssted: Primært Herning, men arbejde i vores øvrige afdelinger kan forekomme.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Vedligeholdelse, fejlfinding og reparation af produktionsmaskiner.

  • Fejlfinding på mekaniske og elektriske systemer.

  • Service af maskiner i vores kødproduktion og opskæringsafdeling.

  • Vedligeholdelse af virksomhedens øvrige tekniske installationer og udstyr.

  • Installation og opstart af nye maskiner.

  • Forebyggende vedligeholdelse for at minimere driftsstop.

Dine kvalifikationer

  • Uddannet maskinmester, automatiktekniker, industrielektriker eller tilsvarende teknisk baggrund.

  • Erfaring med reparation og vedligeholdelse af maskiner.

  • God mekanisk og teknisk forståelse.

  • Selvstændig, fleksibel og løsningsorienteret.

  • Du taler dansk eller engelsk. Tyrkisk er en fordel.

Vi tilbyder

  • En alsidig stilling med ansvar og selvstændighed.

  • Arbejde med en stor og varieret maskinpark.

  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø i en virksomhed i vækst.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.

title: KIA-TEKNIKER SØGES TIL VOKSENDE VÆRKSTEDSTEAM I ESBJERG
description:
Bliv en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor faglighed, teknologi og udvikling går hånd i hånd.

Hos Jørgen Hansen Biler i Esbjerg søger vi endnu en Kia-tekniker, der vil være en del af et stærkt team og et moderne værksted med fokus på kvalitet og faglighed.

Du får mulighed for at arbejde med avanceret fejlfinding, diagnosticering og den nyeste teknologi inden for hybrid- og elbiler, samtidig med at du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor samarbejde, ansvar og godt håndværk er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

 

Hvad kan du forvente hos os?

  • Specialisering og efteruddannelse inden for Kia

  • Arbejde med avanceret fejlfinding, diagnosticering og moderne bilteknologi

  • Et moderne værksted med digitale arbejdsgange og professionelt udstyr

  • Tæt samarbejde med dygtige og erfarne kolleger

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og certificeringer

  • Medindflydelse på din hverdag og faglige udvikling

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

  • En arbejdsplads med ambitioner, struktur og godt fællesskab

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet autotekniker eller mekaniker

  • Erfaring som Kia-tekniker er en fordel, men ikke et krav

  • Har erfaring med fejlfinding og diagnosticering

  • Interesserer dig for ny teknologi, hybrid- og elbiler

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar

  • Bidrager positivt til teamet omkring dig

  • Har fokus på kvalitet og kundetilfredshed

Derfor skal du vælge os

Hos Jørgen Hansen Biler bliver du en del af et moderne bilhus og værksted med ordnede forhold, dygtige kolleger og et stærkt fællesskab. Vi lægger vægt på kvalitet i arbejdet, samarbejde i hverdagen og en arbejdsplads, hvor der er kort vej fra idé til handling.

Klar til at tage næste skridt?

Send din ansøgning og CV til lf@jh-biler.dk eller kontakt servicechef Louise Frost på 76 12 15 08 for en uforpligtende snak.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Dygtige sprøjtemalere søges
description:
Vi søger dygtige og engagerede sprøjtemalere til maling af træ- og stålkonstruktioner.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Sprøjtemaling af træ og stålkonstruktioner

  • Sandblæsning

  • Rengøring og klargøring af emner

  • Diverse forefaldende arbejde i forbindelse med maleropgaver

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring med sprøjtemaling

  • Er kvalitetsbevidst og arbejder selvstændigt

  • Er fleksibel og klar til forskellige typer arbejdsopgaver

  • Som minimum kan tale og forstå engelsk

Vi tilbyder et spændende job med gode kolleger og varierende arbejdsopgaver.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så hører vi gerne fra dig!

title: Rejsemontør / Montør med smede- eller VVS-baggrund
description:
Seamar Scandinavia søger dygtige og stabile rejsemontører til langvarige projektopgaver på Sjælland.

Du bliver en del af et erfarent og engageret team, der arbejder med montage, rørarbejde, rørrensning og tekniske installationer på forskellige anlæg.

Opgaverne kræver teknisk forståelse, evnen til at læse tegninger og en praktisk, løsningsorienteret tilgang. Du skal trives med at arbejde ude på kundernes lokationer og kunne levere et solidt stykke håndværk.

Arbejdsområde

Sjælland.

Arbejdstid

Varierende efter projekt – typisk 4-5 dags uge. Mulighed for overarbejde afhængig af opgave.

Dine primære opgaver

      •     Montage og installation af rør, anlæg og tekniske komponenter

      •     Rørrensning, service og vedligehold af anlæg

      •     Arbejde ud fra tekniske tegninger og instruktioner

      •     Klargøring, test og justering af installationer

      •     Samarbejde med kolleger og projektledere for at sikre fremdrift og kvalitet

      •     Overholdelse af sikkerhedskrav og arbejdsprocedurer

Vi søger dig, der har

      •     Uddannelse eller erfaring som smed, VVS’er, industrimontør eller lignende

      •     Erfaring med montage, tekniske installationer og/eller rørarbejde

      •     Forståelse for tekniske tegninger

      •     Gyldigt kørekort (kategori B)

      •     En selvstændig og ansvarsbevidst tilgang til opgaverne

      •     Fleksibilitet i forhold til arbejdstider og skiftende lokationer, taler og skriver dansk

      •     Gerne erfaring med rørrensning eller procesanlæg – ikke et krav, men en fordel

Vi tilbyder

      •     Langvarige projektopgaver gennem Seamar

      •     Varierende arbejdstid efter projekt og opgavemængde

      •     Løn efter kvalifikationer og overenskomst

      •     Mulighed for overarbejde

      •     Et professionelt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø, hvor der bliver passet på folk

      •     Mulighed for fortsatte opgaver på fremtidige projekter

Sådan søger du

 Send følgende til projekt-coordinator Louise Tilmar Drachmann på mail ltd@seamar.dk

✅ Opdateret CV

✅ Kopi af uddannelsesbevis

✅ Eventuelle gyldige certifikater (fx sikkerhed, truck, svejse, arbejdstilladelser mv.)

✅ Oplysning om kørekort og relevant erfaring

 

Skriv gerne, hvornår du kan starte, og hvor i landet du bor.

Vi kigger løbende på ansøgninger – så søg allerede i dag!

title: Lærer til skole-/behandlingstilbud
description:
Vi søger dygtig og faglig stærk lærer til vores fantastiske skole.

Yderbyskolen er et skole / behandlingstilbud, der tilbyder undervisning og behandling til børn og unge (1.-10.kl og STU).  Eleverne tilbydes undervisning på Yderbyskolen, når mulighederne i folkeskolen og dennes specialundervisning er opbrugte.

Eleverne har indlæringsvanskeligheder / personlige problemer og adfærdsproblemer, der udfordrer dem i hverdagen. Flere af vores elever er udredt med diverse diagnoser.

Mange af eleverne har et nederlagspræget skoleforløb bag sig, ofte med flere skoleskift. Enkelte elever starter skolegang på Yderbyskolen.

Vores fornemste opgave er, at bringe alle elever så langt som muligt, fagligt, socialt og personligt.

Erfaring med tilsvarende opgaver er et absolut plus, men din faglighed, dit engagement og ikke mindst, at du har lyst til at lære fra dig, er et krav.

Til gengæld tilbyder vi dig et fagligt fællesskab i en lille uformel gruppe, hvor vi, i individuelt til passede rammer, sammen skaber unikke muligheder for vores elever.

Der er tale om et fast job på mellem 32 og 37 timer ugentligt.

Ansættelsesvilkår og løn forhandles efter ønsker og kvalifikationer.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtale, så tøv ikke med at sende din ansøgning.

Spørgsmål vedr. stillingen, kan rettes til souschef Dorthe Kamille Semine Christensen på tlf. 60 30 93 06.

title: Agroforestry Manager til Grove Farm Management
description:
Hos Grove Farm Management bygger for fremtidens landbrug. Vi etablerer og driver produktionssystemer med træer og buske. Vi oplever stor vækst og leder efter en operationel, faglig og handlekraftig person der kan tage ansvar for plantning og drift i Midtjylland og Sønderjylland. 

Rollen 

Du bliver ansvarlig for at planlægge og etablere beplantninger med træer og buske på vores egne arealer og hos kunder. Derudover får du ansvaret for drift af vores eget skovlandbrug på 50 ha samt løbende drift-opgaver for vores kunder og samarbejdspartnere. 

Dine ansvarsområder 

  • Etablering: Lede planlægning og etablering af skovlandbrug på tværs af vores lokationer. 

  • Drift: Drift og pleje af arealer med træer. Renholdelse af beplantninger, beskæring, gødskning. Vi driver alle vores arealer økologisk. 

  • Høst: Høst af nødder, bær, frugt, gavntræ, biomasse. 

  • Planteskole: Bistå i driften af vores planteskole – fra indkøb af frømateriale og stiklinger til podning og klargøring af salgsklare træer.

  • Plantesundhed & Vedligehold: Sikre systematisk beskæring, ukrudtshåndtering og høstoptimering, så vores udbytte matcher vores kommercielle kontrakter. 

  • Udvikling og innovation: Arbejde tæt sammen med vores udviklings-team om udvikling og innovation indenfor skovlandbrug. Vi søger hele tiden at skubbe grænserne for kommercielle skovlandbrug og laver løbende markforsøg på vores kommercielle arealer og deltager i forskningsprojekter. 

  • Rundvisninger: Faciliteter rundvisninger og markvandringer for diverse grupper (landbrugsskoler, kommuner, virksomheder, ERFA, ). 

Om dig

  • Du har en stærk faglig baggrund (skov- og landskabsingeniør, agronom, produktionsgartner, jordbrugsteknolog eller lignende).

description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

Hvorfor starte processen nu – hvis du vil afsted i januar 2027?

1. Du får adgang til de bedste stillinger

Virksomhederne vi samarbejder med rekrutterer løbende, og mange stillinger bliver besat flere måneder før opstart. Starter du processen nu, øger du chancen for at få præcis den rolle og det land, du ønsker.

2. Du sikrer en glidende overgang efter studiet

Når du starter i god tid, kan du planlægge dit sabbatår uden tidspres. Du får ro til at afslutte dit studie, nyde efteråret og samtidig være klar til at rejse ud i januar — uden at skulle haste gennem interviews og praktiske forberedelser.

3. Vi kan matche dig med den helt rigtige virksomhed

Vi arbejder ikke med “første og bedste” løsning. Vi matcher dig med virksomheder, der passer til dine ønsker, dine styrker og dine mål for sabbatåret. Det kræver tid — og det er en klar fordel at starte før alle andre.

4. Du får fuld rådgivning hele vejen

Fra første samtale til du står på flyet, hjælper vi dig med:

  • Jobmuligheder

  • Kontrakt og løn

  • Bolig og økonomi

  • Kultur og hverdagsliv

  • Interviewforberedelse

  • Praktiske forhold som bank, skat og relocation

Jo tidligere du starter, desto mere ro og overblik får du.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Du kan se hele oversigten her: https://www.jobhuntworldwide.com/sabbataar-udlandet-gode-tips

Kort sagt får du:

  • Gratis og uforpligtende samtale

  • Hjælp til at finde det rette job i udlandet

  • Professionel interviewforberedelse

  • Rådgivning om bolig, økonomi og kontrakt

  • Relocation‑support (fly, hotel, firmabolig m.m.)

  • Løbende kontakt med relevante virksomheder

  • Tryghed og støtte hele vejen til afrejse

Du kan booke en samtale med os allerede i dag, og så starter vi løbende interviews op med de virksomheder, der passer til dine ønsker og din profil.

title: Postdoc in environmental medicine
description:
The translational pharmacology research group at Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine (CPPEM), Department of Public Health, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a fully funded 18 months postdoctoral position. The position is to be filled from January 1st, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.


About the Research Environment

The research areas of CPPEM span from pharmacoepidemiology to clinical studies, and cell-based basic pharmacology and environmental medicine. Collectively, CPPEM has a strong background in exposure to environmental chemicals, pharmacoepidemiology, pharmacogenetics, pharmacokinetics, drug-drug interactions, and therapeutic drug monitoring. Specifically, the translational pharmacology group aims to understand variability in drug toxicity, drug metabolism and drug transport. Examples of this include cell-based models such as induced-pluripotent stem cells, primary human hepatocytes, and clinical studies. The pharmacoepidemiological research group utilizes the world-class Danish registries as well as international data sources to assess pharmacological questions in large populations. The environmental medicine group studies the impact of early life exposures to environmental chemicals. In particular PFAS is a focus area, with studies of the adverse health effects of exposure, biomonitoring and advising national and international authorities. The analytical chemistry laboratory analyzes concentrations of drugs or environmental chemicals in various matrices. 

In the Environmental Medicine group we are looking for a post doc funded by Novo Nordic Foundation and ERC advanced grant. The projects focus on the Odense Child Cohort and study the impact of early life exposures to environmental chemicals. Especially PFAS and their adverse effects on maternal and child health (e.g. the brain, immune, metabolic and reproductive system). In addition, we aim to identify toxicity of short PFAS including trifluoroacetic acid, widely used but considered less toxic due to their short half-life. 

We are seeking a candidate with a PhD in medicine, pharmacology, public health, or a related discipline. Work within environmental medicine is an advance, and epidemiological and statistical skills are essential. Motivation, curiosity, and a strong drive to excel in environmental research are very important. Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English is a requirement. The position includes independent scientific writing, clinical project leading, and supervision of students. You should be interested in contributing both to the scientific armamentarium in our department and to our collegial culture. It is also expected that the post doc contributes to additional fundraising for the projects as well as research collaborations and the continuation of the Odense Child Cohort, and takes on teaching responsibilities within the department. You will, in your daily work, refer to Professor Tina Kold Jensen, but also engage in a very active collaboration with the full research group.


Your qualifications

  • PhD in medicine, pharmacology, public health, or a related discipline.

  • Experience within environmental medicine is considered an advantage

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Ability to work independently with scientific writing and publication

  • Interest in and experience with supervision of students

  • Commitment to contributing to both scientific excellence and a positive collegial culture within the department

  • Interest in establishing and maintaining national and international research collaboration
     

Further information

Interviews can be performed online if needed. If you will need to relocate to Denmark for the position, both the University and the research group will provide ample support.

Additional information about the position can be obtained from Tina Kold Jensen (tkjensen@health.sdu.dk; 0045 29464350).


Salary and terms of employment

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).


Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now".

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivational letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (including documentation of Master’s and PhD degree) 

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • Up to 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. 

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a description of research experience

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk 

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered. 


Application deadline

November 4, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).


Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.


Living and working in Denmark 

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment.  

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark.  

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background. 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and encourages all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of personal background.
 

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark is a world-class university driven by an ambition to promote research results that develop society. The major challenges of the 21st century are complex and multifaceted; sustainable change and solutions require new – often interdisciplinary – research-based knowledge, and the University of Southern Denmark is an indispensable stakeholder in the transition process. 

Value, quality, talented people and outstanding environments are pivotal for the University of Southern Denmark’s strategic initiatives. 

Read more: https://www.sdu.dk/en/om_sdu

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and encourages all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of personal background.

title: PhD Position in Data-driven Critical Raw Material Supply Chain Resilience
description:
Do you want to investigate the resilience of critical raw material supply chains supporting low-carbon and digital technologies? Join us as a PhD student at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, University of Southern Denmark.

The Department of Green Technology at the University of Southern Denmark invites applications for a three-year PhD position in data-driven critical raw material supply chain resilience.

The position will be based at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, Department of Green Technology, Faculty of Engineering, at the SDU Odense campus. The expected starting date is 15 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

Project Overview

The deployment of low-carbon technologies, electrification and digital infrastructure is increasing global demand for critical raw materials. At the same time, the production and processing of many of these materials are geographically concentrated and exposed to geopolitical, economic, environmental and logistical disruptions.

Understanding how technology development affects material demand, in-use stocks, end-of-life flows and global supply dependencies is therefore important for assessing and strengthening the resilience of critical raw material supply chains.

The PhD position is jointly funded through research projects on critical raw material supply chains and material requirements for Denmark’s climate-neutral transition. The project will be embedded in an interdisciplinary research environment combining environmental systems analysis, supply-chain research and data science.

 

PhD Topic Description

The PhD project will develop modular and data-driven approaches for analysing critical raw material demand, supply-chain dependencies and resilience.

A central methodological contribution will be the development of transparent, reusable and reproducible computational modules for dynamic material flow analysis. The modules will support the integration of technology deployment scenarios, material intensities, product lifetimes, stocks and flows, end-of-life management, recycling, production, trade, facility and ownership data.

The developed approaches will be applied to selected technology systems, including Denmark’s wind-energy infrastructure and the rapidly expanding infrastructure supporting data centres and AI computing. These cases will be analysed within a common methodological framework to examine how infrastructure expansion and technological change influence demand for critical and scarce materials, in-use stocks, future waste flows, recycling potential and global supply-chain dependencies.

The project may also investigate overlapping material requirements and competition for materials across low-carbon and digital technologies. Particular attention may be given to supply concentration, host–by-product dependencies, trade and ownership structures, supply bottlenecks, cascading risks and potential resilience strategies.

Depending on the candidate’s academic background and the specific research questions, the project may include network analysis, geospatial analysis, scenario modelling, uncertainty analysis, machine learning and other AI-supported approaches.

The candidate will build on selected existing models, datasets and research activities in the group and further develop scientifically robust and reusable methods that improve transparency, comparability and reproducibility in material-system research.

The exact research focus and detailed PhD plan will be developed jointly with the successful candidate, taking into account the project objectives, academic background and research interests.

In addition to a PhD dissertation and high-quality scientific publications, the project is expected to produce reusable modelling methods, documented datasets and reproducible computational workflows.

 

PhD Position and Research Environment

As a PhD student, you will conduct independent research under the supervision of an interdisciplinary team, contribute to high-quality scientific publications and participate actively in a collaborative research environment.

You will join SDU Life Cycle Engineering, where research covers industrial ecology, material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, circular economy, resource systems and sustainability transitions.

The project connects expertise in engineering, data science, mathematics, business, supply-chain research and geological resources. The wider research environment includes competences in material flow analysis, critical raw material systems, data mining, network analysis, supply-chain science, finance, investment, ownership structures, geological resources and technology systems.

The position provides opportunities for collaboration across SDU faculties and with external research partners. It may also include participation in international conferences, research visits and collaboration with relevant industrial and public-sector stakeholders.

The PhD programme follows the Danish PhD framework and includes coursework, participation in active research environments, dissemination activities, and teaching or other knowledge-dissemination duties.

 

What We Expect

We are looking for a highly motivated, independent and collaborative candidate with a strong interest in critical raw materials, quantitative modelling, data-driven research and sustainability.

Applicants must hold a relevant master’s degree or equivalent by the time of enrolment. Relevant academic backgrounds may include engineering, industrial ecology, sustainability science, resource management, data science, computer science, applied mathematics, operations research, supply-chain management, geoinformatics, mining or geological sciences, or another relevant natural science or quantitative discipline.

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

  • A solid academic foundation in quantitative analysis, system modelling, data science or related methods. 

  • Experience with programming and data analysis, preferably using Python or a similar programming language. 

  • Experience with data handling, including data cleaning, transformation, integration and exploratory analysis. 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 

  • The ability to work independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment. 

  • Good written and spoken English. 

  • A strong interest in sustainability, critical raw materials and supply-chain resilience. 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage:

  • Material flow analysis, industrial ecology or material systems modelling. 

  • Network, supply-chain or geospatial analysis. 

  • Scientific computing and reproducible research workflows. 

  • Statistics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, optimisation, uncertainty or scenario analysis. 

  • International trade, production facility or corporate ownership data. 

  • Critical raw materials, wind energy, digital infrastructure or data centres. 

Applicants are not expected to possess expertise in all these areas. Prior experience with material flow analysis is an advantage but is not a requirement. Relevant training will be provided according to the candidate’s background and the needs of the project.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

The application must be submitted in English through the SDU online recruitment system.

Assessment of applicants will be based on the submitted application material. The application must include:

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • A motivated application describing the applicant’s research interests, relevant qualifications and motivation for applying. 

  • Documentation of academic qualifications, including bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and complete transcripts of grades. 

  • Official English translations of documents not issued in English or Danish. 

  • Two letters of recommendation. 

  • A list of publications and up to two examples of relevant publications, if available. 

  • The completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • The completed TEK form for calculation of grade-point average. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Official documentation describing the grading system of the awarding university, if the degree was not obtained in Denmark. 

  • Examples of relevant thesis work, software, code repositories or other research outputs, where available. 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

For administrative questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our email support.

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. The place of employment is in Odense, Denmark and preferred starting date is February 15, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

 

Further Information

Further information about the scientific content of the position is available from:

Wu Chen
Associate Professor
Department of Green Technology
SDU Life Cycle Engineering
University of Southern Denmark

title: CTO / Teknisk chef – Produktudvikling og kompositmaterialer
description:
Nordic Platform A/S – Haderslev

Vil du stå i spidsen for den tekniske udvikling i en international produktionsvirksomhed med store vækstambitioner?

Nordic Platform A/S søger en teknisk stærk og udviklingsorienteret CTO / Teknisk chef, der vil være med til at videreudvikle vores kompositprodukter til den internationale stilladsbranche.

Vi er en dansk virksomhed med hovedkontor i Haderslev og aktiviteter i både Europa og USA. Vi udvikler og leverer kompositplatforme og fodspark til nogle af de internationale stilladsproducenter og leverandører.

Vi er i en spændende vækstfase, hvor både vores produktportefølje, kundekreds og internationale aktiviteter udvikler sig hurtigt. Derfor søger vi en person, der kan tage det overordnede tekniske ansvar og være med til at forme vores fremtidige produkter.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som CTO / Teknisk chef får du en central rolle i virksomheden og kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores CEO, internationale salgsteam, kunder og produktionspartnere.

Dine primære opgaver bliver:

  • Udvikling og optimering af vores kompositplatforme, fodspark og tilhørende komponenter.

  • Konstruktion, tekniske tegninger og produktionsdokumentation.

  • Beregninger af styrke, belastning og nedbøjning, herunder FEM/FEA-analyser.

  • Planlægning og gennemførelse af produkttest og kvalitetssikring.

  • Arbejde med internationale standarder, tekniske godkendelser og certificeringer, herunder EN 12811.

  • Teknisk sparring med vores kunder og samarbejdspartnere i Europa og USA.

  • Samarbejde med vores produktionspartnere i Kina og Letland om produktforbedringer, kvalitet og nye løsninger.

  • Udvikling af nye profiler, endestykker, samlingsløsninger og andre komponenter.

  • Strukturering og prioritering af vores tekniske udviklingsprojekter fra idé til færdigt produkt.

Du får både mulighed for at arbejde med den daglige tekniske drift og med langsigtede udviklingsprojekter.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har en ingeniøruddannelse inden for eksempelvis maskinteknik, konstruktion, mekanik, materialeteknologi eller kompositmaterialer.

Du har gerne erfaring med produktudvikling, konstruktion og beregninger, men du behøver ikke nødvendigvis have arbejdet specifikt med komposit eller stilladsbranchen tidligere.

Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:

  • Har en solid teknisk forståelse og interesse for produktudvikling.

  • Har erfaring med 3D CAD og tekniske konstruktionstegninger.

  • Har kendskab til styrkeberegninger og gerne FEM/FEA.

  • Kan omsætte idéer og kundebehov til konkrete, producerbare løsninger.

  • Arbejder struktureret og kan bevare overblikket over flere projekter.

  • Er praktisk orienteret og trives med at finde løsninger frem for kun at beskrive problemer.

  • Kan kommunikere på engelsk med internationale kunder og leverandører.

  • Trives i en mindre virksomhed, hvor beslutningsvejene er korte, og hvor man selv er med til at få tingene til at ske.

Erfaring med kompositmaterialer, pultrudering, produktgodkendelser eller international produktion vil være en fordel, men er ikke et krav.

Vi er åbne for både den erfarne tekniske profil og den ambitiøse ingeniør, der er klar til at tage et større ansvar.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Hos Nordic Platform bliver du en del af en virksomhed med store ambitioner og en stærk international udvikling.

Du får:

  • En central teknisk rolle med stor indflydelse på vores fremtidige produkter.

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med innovative kompositløsninger til et internationalt marked.

  • Tæt samarbejde med ledelsen og direkte indflydelse på beslutninger.

  • En varieret hverdag med både udvikling, konstruktion, test og internationale samarbejder.

  • Stor frihed under ansvar og mulighed for at præge opbygningen af vores tekniske funktion.

  • Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling i takt med virksomhedens vækst.

Vi har en uformel omgangstone, korte beslutningsveje og lægger vægt på, at gode idéer hurtigt kan omsættes til handling.

Om Nordic Platform

Nordic Platform A/S er en dansk virksomhed med speciale i udvikling og produktion af højstyrke-kompositprodukter til stilladsindustrien.

Vores produkter sælges internationalt, blandt andet under AIRSTEPS-navnet og som OEM-løsninger til etablerede stilladsproducenter.

Vi har hovedkontor i Haderslev, salgskontor i München og aktiviteter i USA gennem Nordic Platform Inc. i Houston.

Vi arbejder målrettet med at udvide vores internationale position og udvikle nye løsninger, der kombinerer lav vægt, høj styrke og lang levetid.

Interesseret?

Har du lyst til at blive en del af Nordic Platforms videre udvikling, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og CV til:

Per Mose Jakobsen
CEO & Partner
pm@nordicplatform.dk

description:

Vi tilbyder

Arbejdssted: Middelfart

We offer:

  • An exciting position with responsibility and the opportunity to influence the development of the kitchen

  • The opportunity to develop new dishes and menus

  • A professional and dynamic working environment

This is a full-time position. Salary and employment terms will be agreed according to qualifications and experience.

We are looking for a sous chef who not only knows how to prepare yakitori, but who has a strong professional understanding of the entire yakitori process and can help develop and operate a professional yakitori kitchen.

title: Senior Security Consultant – Incident Response
description:
Do you want to be on the frontline when serious cyber incidents hit? You will lead complex investigations, guide customers through crises, and help shape our incident response services. You will join a highly skilled, collaborative team working with some of the most interesting and challenging cyber cases in the market. 

 

Make a real impact in high‑stakes incidents 

You will be part of a small, expert Incident Response team handling everything from ransomware to targeted attacks across large, complex environments. You will work closely with customers, helping them stay calm, informed and in control during critical situations. You will collaborate with specialists across MDR, Intelligence and Consulting, learn from unique cases, and contribute to the development of tools, methodologies and publications. At CSIS, we invest in your growth with dedicated training time, certifications, and peer learning - in an open, diverse and friendly culture built on “We commit, We care, We succeed together.” 

When you join CSIS, you will get an interesting job in a company and an industry which is growing. You will get interesting challenges, that truly make a difference for our customers, and you will be able to take ownership for your work from start to finish. And you will not least get 130+ fantastic colleagues from all over the world. Besides that, you will get: 

  • Flexible work from home arrangements 

  • A competitive salary and personal benefit package 

  • 5 weeks holiday, plus 5 extra days off each year 

  • Health Insurance, a pension, plus life and disability insurance 

  • Healthy, varied lunches (incl. vegetarian and allergy options) 

  • Home-baked goods, healthy snacks, coffee, tea and sodas in the office

  • Social activities and company events throughout the year

  • Paid mobile phone subscription and home internet 

 

Your new job 

In this client-facing role, you will lead major incident response engagements, support multiple customers, guide junior responders, and help clients strengthen their detection and response capabilities. You will work across diverse environments, industries, and technologies, making adaptability and strong communication essential.  

Your responsibilities will be: 

  • Incident Response & Investigations (Client-Facing) 

  • Lead complex and high-severity incident response engagements for customers across varied infrastructures (on-prem, cloud, hybrid). 

  • Perform advanced forensic analysis across a variety of data sources (disk, memory, network, malware, cloud) and provide clients with clear, actionable findings. 

  • Coordinate response activities with client technical teams, management, and legal/compliance contacts. 

  • Develop accurate incident timelines, attribution assessments (where possible), and root-cause analyses. 

  • Customer Communication & Advisory 

  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients during and after incidents, providing guidance on containment, recovery, and long-term improvements. 

  • Deliver polished, professional technical reports and executive summaries for clients. 

  • Present findings to technical teams as well as to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders. 

  • Preparedness, Consulting & Continuous Improvement 

  • Assist clients with incident readiness assessments, IR playbook creation, tabletop exercises, and contribute to CSIS’s MDR detection engineering. 

  • Contribute to development of internal incident response methodologies, tooling, and best practices. 

  • Mentor and guide junior team members during engagements and internal training. 

 

About you 

You are an experienced incident responder who remains calm and structured under pressure. You enjoy working closely with customers, translating complex technical issues into clear business language, and you value collaboration and knowledge sharing. You are curious, proactive and driven by making a real difference in the fight against cybercrime. 

You bring most of the following: 

Qualifications & Technical Expertise 

  • Hands-on incident response experience, ideally in a consultancy, MSSP, DFIR, or CSIRT environment. 

  • Proven track record leading multi-client or multi-environment incident investigations. 

  • Deep knowledge of Windows, Linux, and Active Directory security.  

  • Strong knowledge of network protocols and security 

  • Strong experience with SIEM and EDR tools, including detection logic, log correlation, and threat analysis. Hands-on experience with Sentinel/Defender and CrowdStrike a plus. 

  • Advanced digital forensics experience (memory, disk, log, network). 

  • Familiarity with evidence handling, chain-of-custody standards, and forensic reporting. 

  • Strong understanding of attack techniques and threat actor behaviours (MITRE ATT&CK). 

  • Experience in cloud investigations (Azure/AWS/GCP logs, identity, telemetry). 

 

Consultancy-Specific Requirements 

  • Ability to manage multiple parallel client engagements and prioritize effectively. 

  • Excellent client-facing communication: confident, calm, and credible during crises. 

  • Strong written documentation skills for both highly technical and non-technical readers. 

  • Ability to scope engagements, set expectations, and represent the company professionally. 

 

Regulatory & Governance Knowledge 

  • Familiarity with European cybersecurity requirements, especially NIS2, GDPR breach handling, and relevant ISO standards. 

  • Ability to advise clients on improving governance, detection maturity, and incident readiness. 

 

Preferred Skills 

  • Danish speaker – English only can be accomodated. 

  • Threat hunting experience or development of hunting hypotheses. 

  • Scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash). 

  • Experience in red team/purple team activities or adversary emulation. 

  • Experience providing IR training or running tabletop exercises. 

 

Relevant Certifications  

  • GIAC: GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GCFE, GPEN, GNFA. 

  • OSCP, CISSP, CISM, or cloud security certs (Azure/AWS/GCP). 

  • Equivalent real-world experience also highly considered and appriciated. 

 

Personal Competencies 

  • Professional, customer-oriented communication style. 

  • Ability to remain composed and decisive under pressure. 

  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail. 

  • Leadership qualities and ability to mentor junior responders. 

  • Curiosity and passion for threat research, attacker behaviour, and continuous learning. 

 

This is a 24/7/365 function — flexibility, out-of-hours work, on-call coverage and occasional travel is required. 

 

Other conditions 

  • Security Clearance: As you may work with some of our public sector customers, a Security Clearance may be required. 

  • Relocation: The position is based out of our offices in Denmark, with some flexibility of remote working. Relocation can also be offered to Denmark if relevant

title: Postdoc in environmental medicine
description:
The translational pharmacology research group at Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine (CPPEM), Department of Public Health, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a fully funded 18 months postdoctoral position. The position is to be filled from January 1st, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.


About the Research Environment

The research areas of CPPEM span from pharmacoepidemiology to clinical studies, and cell-based basic pharmacology and environmental medicine. Collectively, CPPEM has a strong background in exposure to environmental chemicals, pharmacoepidemiology, pharmacogenetics, pharmacokinetics, drug-drug interactions, and therapeutic drug monitoring. Specifically, the translational pharmacology group aims to understand variability in drug toxicity, drug metabolism and drug transport. Examples of this include cell-based models such as induced-pluripotent stem cells, primary human hepatocytes, and clinical studies. The pharmacoepidemiological research group utilizes the world-class Danish registries as well as international data sources to assess pharmacological questions in large populations. The environmental medicine group studies the impact of early life exposures to environmental chemicals. In particular PFAS is a focus area, with studies of the adverse health effects of exposure, biomonitoring and advising national and international authorities. The analytical chemistry laboratory analyzes concentrations of drugs or environmental chemicals in various matrices. 

In the Environmental Medicine group we are looking for a post doc funded by Novo Nordic Foundation and ERC advanced grant. The projects focus on the Odense Child Cohort and study the impact of early life exposures to environmental chemicals. Especially PFAS and their adverse effects on maternal and child health (e.g. the brain, immune, metabolic and reproductive system). In addition, we aim to identify toxicity of short PFAS including trifluoroacetic acid, widely used but considered less toxic due to their short half-life. 

We are seeking a candidate with a PhD in medicine, pharmacology, public health, or a related discipline. Work within environmental medicine is an advance, and epidemiological and statistical skills are essential. Motivation, curiosity, and a strong drive to excel in environmental research are very important. Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English is a requirement. The position includes independent scientific writing, clinical project leading, and supervision of students. You should be interested in contributing both to the scientific armamentarium in our department and to our collegial culture. It is also expected that the post doc contributes to additional fundraising for the projects as well as research collaborations and the continuation of the Odense Child Cohort, and takes on teaching responsibilities within the department. You will, in your daily work, refer to Professor Tina Kold Jensen, but also engage in a very active collaboration with the full research group.


Your qualifications

  • PhD in medicine, pharmacology, public health, or a related discipline.

  • Experience within environmental medicine is considered an advantage

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Ability to work independently with scientific writing and publication

  • Interest in and experience with supervision of students

  • Commitment to contributing to both scientific excellence and a positive collegial culture within the department

  • Interest in establishing and maintaining national and international research collaboration
     

Further information

Interviews can be performed online if needed. If you will need to relocate to Denmark for the position, both the University and the research group will provide ample support.

Additional information about the position can be obtained from Tina Kold Jensen (tkjensen@health.sdu.dk; 0045 29464350).


Salary and terms of employment

title: PhD Position in Data-driven Critical Raw Material Supply Chain Resilience
description:
Do you want to investigate the resilience of critical raw material supply chains supporting low-carbon and digital technologies? Join us as a PhD student at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, University of Southern Denmark.

The Department of Green Technology at the University of Southern Denmark invites applications for a three-year PhD position in data-driven critical raw material supply chain resilience.

The position will be based at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, Department of Green Technology, Faculty of Engineering, at the SDU Odense campus. The expected starting date is 15 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

Project Overview

The deployment of low-carbon technologies, electrification and digital infrastructure is increasing global demand for critical raw materials. At the same time, the production and processing of many of these materials are geographically concentrated and exposed to geopolitical, economic, environmental and logistical disruptions.

Understanding how technology development affects material demand, in-use stocks, end-of-life flows and global supply dependencies is therefore important for assessing and strengthening the resilience of critical raw material supply chains.

The PhD position is jointly funded through research projects on critical raw material supply chains and material requirements for Denmark’s climate-neutral transition. The project will be embedded in an interdisciplinary research environment combining environmental systems analysis, supply-chain research and data science.

 

PhD Topic Description

The PhD project will develop modular and data-driven approaches for analysing critical raw material demand, supply-chain dependencies and resilience.

A central methodological contribution will be the development of transparent, reusable and reproducible computational modules for dynamic material flow analysis. The modules will support the integration of technology deployment scenarios, material intensities, product lifetimes, stocks and flows, end-of-life management, recycling, production, trade, facility and ownership data.

The developed approaches will be applied to selected technology systems, including Denmark’s wind-energy infrastructure and the rapidly expanding infrastructure supporting data centres and AI computing. These cases will be analysed within a common methodological framework to examine how infrastructure expansion and technological change influence demand for critical and scarce materials, in-use stocks, future waste flows, recycling potential and global supply-chain dependencies.

The project may also investigate overlapping material requirements and competition for materials across low-carbon and digital technologies. Particular attention may be given to supply concentration, host–by-product dependencies, trade and ownership structures, supply bottlenecks, cascading risks and potential resilience strategies.

Depending on the candidate’s academic background and the specific research questions, the project may include network analysis, geospatial analysis, scenario modelling, uncertainty analysis, machine learning and other AI-supported approaches.

The candidate will build on selected existing models, datasets and research activities in the group and further develop scientifically robust and reusable methods that improve transparency, comparability and reproducibility in material-system research.

The exact research focus and detailed PhD plan will be developed jointly with the successful candidate, taking into account the project objectives, academic background and research interests.

In addition to a PhD dissertation and high-quality scientific publications, the project is expected to produce reusable modelling methods, documented datasets and reproducible computational workflows.

 

PhD Position and Research Environment

As a PhD student, you will conduct independent research under the supervision of an interdisciplinary team, contribute to high-quality scientific publications and participate actively in a collaborative research environment.

You will join SDU Life Cycle Engineering, where research covers industrial ecology, material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, circular economy, resource systems and sustainability transitions.

The project connects expertise in engineering, data science, mathematics, business, supply-chain research and geological resources. The wider research environment includes competences in material flow analysis, critical raw material systems, data mining, network analysis, supply-chain science, finance, investment, ownership structures, geological resources and technology systems.

The position provides opportunities for collaboration across SDU faculties and with external research partners. It may also include participation in international conferences, research visits and collaboration with relevant industrial and public-sector stakeholders.

The PhD programme follows the Danish PhD framework and includes coursework, participation in active research environments, dissemination activities, and teaching or other knowledge-dissemination duties.

 

What We Expect

We are looking for a highly motivated, independent and collaborative candidate with a strong interest in critical raw materials, quantitative modelling, data-driven research and sustainability.

Applicants must hold a relevant master’s degree or equivalent by the time of enrolment. Relevant academic backgrounds may include engineering, industrial ecology, sustainability science, resource management, data science, computer science, applied mathematics, operations research, supply-chain management, geoinformatics, mining or geological sciences, or another relevant natural science or quantitative discipline.

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

  • A solid academic foundation in quantitative analysis, system modelling, data science or related methods. 

  • Experience with programming and data analysis, preferably using Python or a similar programming language. 

  • Experience with data handling, including data cleaning, transformation, integration and exploratory analysis. 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 

  • The ability to work independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment. 

  • Good written and spoken English. 

  • A strong interest in sustainability, critical raw materials and supply-chain resilience. 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage:

  • Material flow analysis, industrial ecology or material systems modelling. 

  • Network, supply-chain or geospatial analysis. 

  • Scientific computing and reproducible research workflows. 

  • Statistics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, optimisation, uncertainty or scenario analysis. 

  • International trade, production facility or corporate ownership data. 

  • Critical raw materials, wind energy, digital infrastructure or data centres. 

Applicants are not expected to possess expertise in all these areas. Prior experience with material flow analysis is an advantage but is not a requirement. Relevant training will be provided according to the candidate’s background and the needs of the project.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

The application must be submitted in English through the SDU online recruitment system.

Assessment of applicants will be based on the submitted application material. The application must include:

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • A motivated application describing the applicant’s research interests, relevant qualifications and motivation for applying. 

  • Documentation of academic qualifications, including bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and complete transcripts of grades. 

  • Official English translations of documents not issued in English or Danish. 

  • Two letters of recommendation. 

  • A list of publications and up to two examples of relevant publications, if available. 

  • The completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • The completed TEK form for calculation of grade-point average. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Official documentation describing the grading system of the awarding university, if the degree was not obtained in Denmark. 

  • Examples of relevant thesis work, software, code repositories or other research outputs, where available. 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

For administrative questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our email support.

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. The place of employment is in Odense, Denmark and preferred starting date is February 15, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

 

Further Information

Further information about the scientific content of the position is available from:

Wu Chen
Associate Professor
Department of Green Technology
SDU Life Cycle Engineering
University of Southern Denmark
Email: wuc@igt.sdu.dk

For administrative questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our email support.
