title: OPERATEUR AMIANTE F/H
description:
Fort des compétences de sa filiale de démolition XARDEL, acquise en 2011, le Groupe COSTANTINI est en mesure de réaliser tous types de travaux de démolition et de déconstruction sélective, jusqu'au tri et la revalorisation des matériaux.


Avec un parc matériel spécifique de plus de 30 machines et une équipe d'opérateurs confirmés, nous sommes capables de proposer des solutions techniques à des démolitions d'immeubles de plus de 30 mètres de hauteur, des ouvrages d'art de tous types, des usines, des maisons individuelles ou même des démolitions intérieures pour réhabilitation.


Nous sommes également en mesure de réaliser des travaux de désamiantage intérieurs ou extérieurs dans le cadre de nos opérations.


La démolition est un métier technique et parfois complexe. Nous avons le savoir-faire et les moyens techniques pour vous accompagner dans vos travaux futurs.


Pour renforcer son équipe de Niederkorn (LU), XARDEL recherche un Opérateur Amiante F/H


Responsabilités :


L'Opérateur Amiante F/H effectue le retrait des matériaux amiantés en respectant strictement les consignes de la hiérarchie.

Voici vos missions :

    Mettre en place les installations de chantier (balisage, confinement, dépression, SAS) et préparer le terrain, les outils, les matériaux nécessaires à l'exécution des travaux,

    Réaliser les travaux de retrait des matériaux contenant de l'amiante dans le respect du plan de retrait établi,

    Repérer, séparer et enlever les différents matériaux : bois, métaux, bardages, déchets inertes (plastique, revêtement) sous la directive du chef de chantier,

    Effectuer les opérations de décontamination (personnelle, matériels, zones) en respectant les consignes de sécurité,

    Assurer le conditionnement, l'étiquetage et l'évacuation des déchets amiantés,

    Renseigner les documents de suivi de chantier (traçabilité, rapports) et rendre compte à la hiérarchie de l'avancement des travaux,

    Utiliser et entretenir les appareils de protection respiratoire et les équipements de protection individuelle (EPI) et collective (EPC).


Compétences requises :

    Connaissance des risques liés à l'amiante (toxicité, pathologies associées, réglementation),

    Lecture et compréhension des modes opératoires (plan de retrait, notice de poste, procédures SS4),

    Savoir reconnaître les matériaux susceptibles de contenir de l'amiante,

    Respect strict des consignes de sécurité (EPI, confinements, décontamination),

    Capacité à utiliser le matériel spécifique (aspirateurs à filtration absolue, unités de décontamination, équipements de confinement),

    Communication et remontée d'informations (alerte en cas de situation à risque),

    Habile de ses mains, disponible et doté·e d'une bonne résistance physique.


Compétences utiles :

    La possession d'ACS/CACES engins de chantier et/ou d'une formation amiante SS3 ou SS4 est considérée comme un atout,

    Connaissance des normes de sécurité.


Nous offrons :

    Un poste à pourvoir immédiatement dans une entreprise dynamique et en pleine croissance,

    Rémunération selon profil et expérience,

    Mutuelle Santé obligatoire et prise en charge à 100%,

    Parcours de formation

title: Senior Unified Communications Engineer — Cisco & Microsoft Teams (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:

Ingénieur Senior en Communications Unifiées — Cisco & Microsoft Teams (H/F) — CDI à temps complet

Vous souhaitez rejoindre une société dynamique, leader sur son marché et disposant d'un large portefeuille de solutions ? XXXX Group est à la recherche d'un Ingénieur Senior en Communications Unifiées pour concevoir, déployer et supporter des environnements de téléphonie Cisco et Microsoft Teams avancés pour ses clients.

Mission

Vous intégrerez l'équipe UC Cisco & Applications de XXXX S.A. en tant qu'ingénieur senior, et prendrez en charge les solutions de Communications Unifiées Cisco et Microsoft Teams sur l'ensemble de leur cycle de vie — de l'architecture et la conception jusqu'à l'implémentation et le dépannage avancé.
Vous serez le référent technique et le point d'escalade pour les projets et incidents complexes, en intervenant à la fois sur nos propres plateformes et sur site chez nos clients au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région, dans un environnement professionnel exigeant nécessitant rigueur, autonomie, sens du service et bonne gestion des priorités.

Rôle principal

Dans le cadre de vos activités, vous serez notamment amené à:  

• Concevoir des solutions de communications unifiées (Cisco UC, SIP, Microsoft Teams) adaptées aux besoins des clients, en produisant des dossiers d'architecture de haut et bas niveau (HLD/LLD).
• Piloter l'implémentation et le déploiement des solutions UC:  clusters CUCM, passerelles voix, SBC/CUBE, trunks SIP, téléphones IP Cisco, Jabber/Webex, messagerie vocale et téléphonie Microsoft Teams.
• Définir et construire les plans de numérotation, le routage d'appels, les plans de numéros et les politiques de classe de service sur plusieurs sites.
• Agir comme point d'escalade de niveau 3:  diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents complexes voix, réseau et UC.
• Prendre en charge la sécurité UC:  certificats et PKI, TLS/SRTP, enregistrement sécurisé (CTL/ITL, clusters en mixed-mode) et prévention de la fraude téléphonique (toll fraud).
• Intégrer la UC à l'écosystème environnant:  AD/LDAP, présence, messagerie vocale, supervision et outils de ticketing.
• Piloter les migrations et montées de version, y compris les scénarios Cisco vers Teams et de téléphonie hybride.
• Assurer un leadership technique et le mentorat des techniciens et ingénieurs juniors, et contribuer aux bonnes pratiques internes.
• Assurer l'interface avec les clients, les fournisseurs et les équipes internes, en garantissant la qualité, une communication claire et le respect des délais projet.
• Produire et maintenir une documentation technique claire (dossiers de conception, configurations, as-built et procédures d'exploitation).

Profil recherché

Titulaire d'un diplôme de l'enseignement supérieur en informatique, réseaux ou télécommunications (niveau Bac+3 à Bac+5), ou justifiant d'une expérience professionnelle équivalente, vous disposez d'une expérience d'au moins 5 ans dans des projets de communications unifiées, dans un rôle combinant conception, implémentation et support.
Vous avez une capacité avérée à concevoir une solution, à l'implémenter et à la dépanner de bout en bout, et vous êtes à l'aise pour travailler en autonomie dans un environnement structuré et orienté client, avec un haut niveau d'exigence. Vous savez gérer les priorités et garder une communication professionnelle et claire en toute circonstance.
Les certifications Cisco (CCNP Collaboration / CCIE Collaboration) sont fortement appréciées ; les certifications Microsoft (Teams / Microsoft 365) sont un plus.

Compétences

• L'expertise Cisco Unified Communications est obligatoire : connaissance approfondie de CUCM, Unity Connection, IM&P, Jabber, Webex, téléphones IP Cisco, passerelles voix et SBC/CUBE.
• Maîtrise approfondie du protocole SIP (signalisation, négociation SDP, dépannage) et des flux média RTP/SRTP.
• Solides connaissances en sécurité UC et gestion des certificats: TLS, SRTP, PKI et gestion des certificats, enregistrement sécurisé (CTL/ITL), clusters en mixed-mode et lutte contre la fraude téléphonique.
• Socle réseau IT solide: TCP/IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, routage et QoS voix de bout en bout.
• La téléphonie Microsoft Teams est idéale: Teams Phone, Direct Routing, intégration SBC, politiques de routage voix et scénarios hybrides Cisco/Teams.
• Conception et ingénierie de solutions : design de plan de numérotation, haute disponibilité et redondance, Call Admission Control et dimensionnement.
• Dépannage avancé à l'aide des traces SIP/SDL, de RTMT, du Dialed Number Analyzer et de captures réseau (Wireshark).
• Compétences en gestion de projet et en documentation : capacité à piloter des projets techniques et à produire une documentation claire et structurée.

Langues

• Maîtrise du français requise, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
• Bon niveau d'anglais requis (documentation et échanges techniques).
• La maîtrise du luxembourgeois est un atout.

Environnement de travail

Le poste est basé au Luxembourg et combine des activités de projet et de conception avec des interventions sur site chez nos clients au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement où la qualité de service, la réactivité, la précision et la communication sont essentielles.
Ce poste conviendra à un professionnel expérimenté souhaitant prendre en charge des projets complexes de communications unifiées, approfondir son expertise sur les solutions

Cisco et Microsoft, et devenir un référent technique au sein d'un intégrateur ICT de premier plan.

Ce que nous proposons

• Un CDI à temps complet.
• Un package attractif.
• Un cycle continu de formation et la possibilité d'évoluer dans l'entreprise.
• Une équipe dynamique et soudée créant un cadre de travail très agréable.
• Une société où l'employé et le client sont au cœur de toutes les attentions.
• Un groupe leader dont le siège au Luxembourg facilite l'adéquation entre organisation, solutions et attente du marché.

Contraintes éventuelles liées au poste:  Extrait de casier judiciaire exigé

À propos de XXXX Group

Fondé en 1929 au Luxembourg, XXXX Group compte actuellement plus de 150 collaborateurs dans de multiples domaines d'activités et actifs dans les secteurs de la finance (agrément PSF), la santé, l'hôtellerie, l'industrie, les services, le secteur public et les Institutions européennes.
XXXX Group (XXXX, XXXX Security, XXXX Telecom et XXXX Soft) fournit des solutions d'intégration ICT, de services Cloud, de sécurité des bâtiments, d'intégration audiovisuelle et d'opérateur téléphonique au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région ainsi qu'une large palette de solutions IT et un service d'éditeur d'applications métiers.
Nous accompagnons les administrations, les grandes entreprises et les PME avec la même vision claire : se poser en partenaire fiable, flexible et innovant.

Comment postuler
Vous possédez les qualités requises ci-dessus? Veuillez s'il vous plaît envoyer votre lettre de motivation et votre curriculum vitae (en français ou en anglais) à l'adresse jobs@XXXX.com en indiquant « Candidature au poste d'Ingénieur Senior en Communications Unifiées (H/F) ».
Votre candidature sera traitée en toute confidentialité.

title: Lead Engineer (m/w/d) Automotive Qualitätssicherung – Luxemburg / Remote (1719) (Ingenieur/in - Fahrzeugtechnik)
description:
Ihre Karriere in der Produktqualität elektronischer Fahrzeugsysteme.

Sie analysieren kritische Produktprobleme, steuern strukturierte Ursachenanalysen und entwickeln nachhaltige Verbesserungsmaßnahmen. - Fehleranalyse: Sie leiten komplexe Ursachenanalysen mit Methoden wie 8D, FTA und Ishikawa und begleiten die Bearbeitung kritischer Produktprobleme
- Qualitätsverbesserung: Sie erkennen wiederkehrende Fehler- und Qualitätstrends und leiten nachhaltige Korrektur- und Präventionsmaßnahmen ab

- Methodenkompetenz: Sie vermitteln Best Practices der strukturierten Problemlösung und unterstützen die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Entwicklungs- und Qualitätsmethoden

Das bringen Sie mit

- Qualifikation: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Elektronik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung
- Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Automotive, Automobilelektronik, E-Mobilität oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Umfeld sowie erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Steuerung von Projekten oder Teams
- ECU-Entwicklung: Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung elektronischer Steuergeräte, idealerweise im Bereich Hochvolt-Inverter
- Qualitätsmethoden: Praxiserfahrung mit strukturierten Problemlösungsmethoden wie 8D, FTA und Ishikawa sowie ausgeprägtes prozessorientiertes Denken

- Tools: Erfahrung mit Projekt-, Anforderungs- und Ticketmanagementsystemen wie Microsoft Project, Polarion, DOORS, JIRA oder IBM Rational RTC
- Kommunikation: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, interkulturelle Kompetenz sowie Bereitschaft, rund 30 % der Tätigkeit vor Ort in Luxemburg zu arbeiten

Was wir bieten

- Attraktive Konditionen: Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit einer Vergütung, die Ihrer Qualifikation und Erfahrung entspricht
- Flexible Arbeitsweise: Verbinden Sie überwiegend mobiles Arbeiten mit gezielten Projekteinsätzen vor Ort in Luxemburg
- Dynamisches Team: Werden Sie Teil eines internationalen Entwicklungsumfelds, das technische Verantwortung und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit fördert

bewerbung@brueggen-engineering.de

Herr Dipl.-Ing. Thomas Keller

description:

Senior Software Engineer I – Subsidy Projects (Fixed-Term 24 months)

Luxembourg - Esch-sur-Alzette
Full-time
Fixed-term
71,500 - 79,500 € per year

Who we are

Luxembourg National Data Service (LNDS) is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg's strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation. LNDS enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner. The LNDS service portfolio includes know-how, capabilities, tools, infrastructure, and data services. Through efficient & responsible use of data and improving the secondary use of data, LNDS will support the acceleration of economic, ecological, and societal transitions.

Play a key role in the improvement and innovation of IT solutions within a dynamic agile team delivering high-quality services across key data domains. Contribute to major European and national initiatives, including HDAB2-LU, supporting the establishment of the Luxembourg Health Data Access Body and enabling secure, compliant, and efficient access to health data.
Support the delivery of strategic national and European initiatives focused on secure data sharing, health and research data ecosystems, and trustworthy AI adoption. Contribute to the design and implementation of scalable, compliant, and impactful digital solutions in a complex multi-stakeholder environment.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will independently design, implement, deliver and maintain applications and platform services, integrating new solutions with LNDS's existing data-centric infrastructures. You will take ownership of defined technical areas, translating requirements into reliable, secure and maintainable solutions within agreed architectural and organisational standards. You will actively identify and deliver opportunities for continuous improvement and innovation, focusing on:

• Automating the software development lifecycle.
• Improving internal data flows, tooling and platform capabilities.
• Developing and supporting technical environments for data processing, analytics and AI-related experimentation.

At ISL, learning is deeply human. We believe in creating spaces where students feel seen, heard, and inspired to take ownership of their learning. We are currently seeking a passionate and reflective French Language B Teacher - Diploma Programme (DP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP)- to join our vibrant learning community in Luxembourg.

As a French Language B Teacher, you will guide students in developing their language acquisition skills and intercultural understanding through the IB DP and MYP frameworks. At our school, learning is driven by curiosity, inquiry, and hands-on experimentation. We are looking for a teacher who sees teaching as relational, creative and purposeful.

What You'll Do

As our French Language B Teacher, you will:

· Design and facilitate engaging, inquiry-based learning experiences in French Language B across DP and MYP
· Collaborate with colleagues to design interdisciplinary, concept-based, and innovative learning experiences
· Teach and support learners in developing French language acquisition, communication skills, and intercultural understanding
· Create inclusive, differentiated learning environments that support diverse learners
· Foster learner agency, voice, and ownership of learning
· Use assessment and feedback intentionally to guide progress and growth of learners
· Build strong, respectful relationships with learners that promote wellbeing and a sense of belonging
· Using a Learning Management System to organize course materials, support collaboration, and engage students.
· Contributing to the wellbeing and pastoral life of the school, including serving as a student advisor.
· Taking active part in the vibrant life of the school — from parent evenings to community events to leading beyond-the-classroom activities.
· Engage with AI effectively in guiding learners by having a human-centered mindset, promoting ethical principles and responsible use, and providing the knowledge, understanding and skills needed to create and use AI to complement their education.
What will you bring?

Essential:

● Experience teaching IB DP French Language Acquisition and/or MYP French Language B;
● Experience preparing students for IB assessments;
● A recognised teaching qualification and relevant university degree (MA preferred);
● High-level proficiency in French appropriate for teaching Language B;
● Strong skills in inquiry-based, student-centred and differentiated teaching;
● The ability to create inclusive learning experiences for multilingual learners with diverse strengths and needs;
● Strong communication, collaboration and relationship-building skills;
● A reflective, culturally responsive and internationally minded approach to teaching and learning;
● A commitment to safeguarding, student wellbeing and belonging.

Valued Experience:

● Experience preparing students for IGCSE assessments;
● Experience teaching within an international and multilingual school community;
● Experience integrating educational technology and AI thoughtfully into language learning;
● Contributions to advisory, pastoral, co-curricular or beyond-the-classroom programmes.
We are keen to attract applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly those whose nationality, identity, gender or race is currently under-represented in international education.

We are committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expect all staff to share this commitment.

title: Opérateur(trice) de production agroalimentaire (H/F/X)
description:
Description de tâches:

Opérateur(trice) de Production Agroalimentaire (H/F)

CDI – Temps plein – Kleinbettingen (Luxembourg)
Rejoignez un acteur industriel engagé de l'alimentation européenne
Entreprise familiale indépendante fondée au Luxembourg, Les Moulins de Kleinbettingen est un acteur reconnu de la transformation céréalière en Europe.
Depuis onze générations, nous développons un savoir-faire solide dans la fabrication de produits destinés à l'alimentation humaine: farines, semoules, mixes et solutions alimentaires à destination des artisans, industriels et de la grande distribution.

Notre développement repose sur trois piliers essentiels:  qualité – innovation – respect des ressources naturelles

Dans le cadre du développement de nouvelles activités industrielles, nous renforçons nos équipes afin d'accompagner notre croissance et de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence sur l'ensemble de nos lignes de fabrication.

Opérateur(trice) de Production Agroalimentaire (H/F)

Votre mission:

Intégrez une équipe dynamique et participez activement à la fabrication de produits agroalimentaires de qualité.
Sous la responsabilité du Chef d'équipe Production, vous contribuez à la transformation des matières premières en produits finis dans le respect des standards de qualité, d'hygiène, de sécurité et de performance industrielle.
Ce poste vous offre une réelle polyvalence au cœur de l'atelier : vous intervenez sur différentes étapes de la production et pouvez être amené(e) à occuper plusieurs postes selon les besoins. Cette diversité des tâches vous permet de développer vos compétences, de gagner en autonomie et de jouer un rôle clé dans la fluidité de la production.

Vos principales responsabilités:

Production

• Assurer la conduite et la surveillance des équipements d'extrusion.
• Effectuer le suivi des paramètres de production et signaler toute anomalie.
• Veiller au respect des objectifs de production, de qualité et de rendement.
• Réaliser les changements de production selon les procédures établies.

Contrôle qualité

• Effectuer les contrôles horaires des produits en cours de fabrication.
• Réaliser et enregistrer les résultats des contrôles dans le système de gestion de la qualité.
• Prélever des échantillons et effectuer des analyses simples au laboratoire de production:
• Identifier les écarts de qualité et informer la hiérarchie en cas de non-conformité.

Gestion des matières premières

• Assurer le vidage et l'approvisionnement des matières premières nécessaires à la production.
• Contrôler la disponibilité et la conformité des matières utilisées.
• Participer à la gestion des stocks de matières premières selon les procédures en vigueur.

Packaging et préparation de commandes

• Réaliser les opérations de conditionnement et d'emballage des produits finis.
• Vérifier la conformité de l'étiquetage et du conditionnement.
• Préparer les commandes selon les instructions de production et les exigences clients.
• Assurer la traçabilité des produits emballés.

Entretien et nettoyage

• Effectuer le nettoyage régulier des équipements, des postes de travail et des zones de production.
• Respecter les procédures d'hygiène, de sécurité et de nettoyage en vigueur.
• Participer aux opérations de maintenance de premier niveau.

Conditions particulières

• Travail posté selon les besoins de la production.
• Port des équipements de protection individuelle obligatoire.
• Respect strict des procédures qualité, sécurité et hygiène.

Perspectives d'évolution

Ce poste offre une réelle perspective d'évolution vers une fonction de Chef d'équipe Production.
Selon votre engagement, votre maîtrise des équipements et votre capacité à coordonner les activités de production, vous pourrez progressivement évoluer vers un rôle à responsabilités comprenant:

• Encadrement opérationnel d'une équipe de production
• Organisation et suivi des plannings de fabrication
• Coordination des changements de production
• Support technique et organisationnel aux opérateurs
• Contribution active à la performance globale de la ligne

Un accompagnement interne et des formations pourront être proposés afin de soutenir cette évolution.

Compétences requises

• Formation technique, industrielle ou agroalimentaire (ou expérience équivalente)
• Une première expérience en production est un atout, mais non obligatoire
• Vous êtes rigoureux(se), impliqué(e) et appréciez le travail en équipe
• Vous avez le sens des responsabilités et de la qualité
• Vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement industriel structuré
• Vous êtes disponible pour travailler en horaires postés
• Vous maîtrisez le français
• L'anglais et/ou l'allemand constitue un avantage

Nous offrons

• Une entreprise familiale solide et reconnue au niveau européen
• Un environnement industriel moderne en pleine évolution
• Un poste concret, formateur et polyvalent
• Une formation complète à nos procédés et équipements
• Une équipe engagée et un management de proximité
• Une véritable opportunité d'évolution vers un poste de Chef d'équipe Production

Intéressé(e)?
Merci d'envoyer votre candidature (CV + lettre de motivation) à:  benoit.gilson@lesmoulins.lu

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

You will be responsible for implementing the Bank's commercial strategy and risk policy within the Alternative Funds segment, both in Luxembourg and abroad. You will manage and develop profitable client relationships, promote the Institutional Banking Value Proposition, and contribute to the growth of the Alternative Investment Funds business.

Your next challenge:

• Manage and develop a portfolio of clients in the Custodian Banking/Depositary segment and foster long-term relationships through regular client interactions.
• Act as the primary point of contact for clients within BIL, ensuring effective coordination between clients and all relevant internal stakeholders.
• Achieve assigned objectives in terms of revenue, costs, deposit collection and credit production, while actively contributing to the performance of the Alternative Investment Funds (AIF) team and Institutional Banking (IB).
• Promote the IB Value Proposition by developing a thorough understanding of clients' situations and proposing solutions that address their current and future needs.
• Maintain a strong knowledge of BIL's products and services, particularly those dedicated to AIF clients.
• Leverage the expertise available across IB to deliver comprehensive client solutions, drive cross-selling initiatives and identify business growth opportunities in collaboration with the Business Developers.
• Ensure compliance with all applicable policies, procedures and regulatory requirements, including KYC and AML obligations.
• Oversee the operational follow-up of client requests and instructions, working closely with the Business Office and Compliance teams to ensure service quality and efficiency.
• Contribute to knowledge sharing and training initiatives within Institutional Banking by supporting colleagues and continuously developing specialized expertise.
• Act as an ambassador of the BIL Group through participation in conferences, presentations, training sessions and industry events, while maintaining a strong professional network.
• Contribute to the development and enhancement of products and services for AIF clients through an innovative and client-focused approach.

Your skills:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Audit, Law, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• Minimum 5 to 7 years of experience in the banking, fund industry and/or depositary environment.
• Excellent understanding of the AIFMD framework and the related legal and regulatory environment.
• In-depth knowledge of alternative asset classes, including Private Equity, Private Debt, Real Estate and Infrastructure.
• Extensive understanding of banking activities, organisational structures, operational risk management processes and control frameworks.

• Strong analytical, strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent presentation, communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal.
• Team player with an entrepreneurial mindset and a collaborative approach.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of additional languages is considered an asset.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

description:
Job Title:  Risk Officer - Vistra Funds Solutions

Job Description:  
It's never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.  

At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction. But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we're absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that
 
We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as Risk Manager. Reporting to the Managing Director, this full-time and permanent position is based in Luxembourg and offers regional coverage, allowing you to make a significant impact to our Operations and its' growth.

Purpose of the Role

The Risk Officer supports the permanent risk management function under the direction of the Conducting Officer and contributes to the effective implementation and ongoing enhancement of the risk management framework for alternative investment funds across liquid and illiquid strategies.

The role involves monitoring investment and operational risks, overseeing risk limits and controls, supporting regulatory and internal reporting obligations, including Annex IV reporting, and ensuring timely escalation of relevant risk matters where appropriate.

The successful candidate will work closely with internal IFM functions and external stakeholders, including valuation, portfolio management delegates, compliance, and oversight functions, to promote effective risk governance and transparent communication across the organisation.

The position requires strong analytical and organisational capabilities, a good command of risk system applications and reporting tools, and a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset.

The Risk Officer is expected to contribute actively to the continuous development and optimisation of risk processes and controls, demonstrating flexibility, collaboration, and clear communication skills in a dynamic environment. Exposure to UCITS risk management frameworks would be considered an advantage.

Key Responsibilities

Risk monitoring for alternative investment funds

• Support the implementation and ongoing maintenance of the risk management framework for alternative investment funds across liquid and illiquid strategies, including risk monitoring, controls, and limit oversight.
• Perform regular risk reporting activities, including contribution to Annex IV reporting, escalation of breaches or anomalies, and maintenance of accurate risk data within risk management systems.
• Contribute to the enhancement of risk management processes, systems, and operational procedures by identifying practical improvements and supporting the implementation of efficient and scalable solutions
• Responsible of the accuracy and timeliness in the production of risk assessment, analysis and reporting including annex IV.
• Perform the monitoring of investment compliance of the AIFs
• Support the development and enhancement of internally developed risk IT tools, including testing of new reporting solutions, data aggregation processes, controls, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure the accuracy and reliability of risk analytics and reporting.

Client management

• Serve as a key contact for clients on risk management matters, ensuring appropriate escalation of relevant issues to senior members of the permanent risk management function. Support the delivery of regular client reporting and communication on risk exposures, risk monitoring, and related risk management matters, while responding to client queries in a timely and professional manner.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Liaise effectively with internal IFM functions including portfolio management, valuation, compliance, to ensure consistent risk governance and information flow. Present risk findings and reports to AIF senior management.
  
Attributes/Technical Skills

• Good knowledge of alternative investment fund risk management frameworks for liquid and illiquid strategies.
• Understanding of AIFMD regulatory requirements and Annex IV reporting obligations.
• Experience with risk monitoring tools, limit management systems, and risk reporting applications Knowledge of market, liquidity, counterparty, leverage, and operational risk measurement methodologies.
• Ability to analyse and interpret portfolio risk metrics and exposure reports.
• Familiarity with data aggregation, reconciliation controls, and risk data quality processes
• Exposure to user acceptance testing (UAT) and enhancement of internally developed risk systems and reporting tools
• Good command of Excel and risk reporting tools; knowledge of Power BI, SQL, or data visualisation tools would be an advantage
• Understanding of fund structures, valuation processes, and delegated portfolio management oversight within an IFM/AIFM environment
• Ability to identify control gaps and contribute to process improvement initiatives in a regulated environment.

Relevant Experience

• Minimum 3 year of experience and strong background in similar role managing risk for AIFs
• Demonstrated expertise in risk management system and reporting operations.

Education and Professional Qualification

• Bachelor's degree in finance, Economics, Business, Mathematics, or a related field.
• Advanced degree or relevant professional certification (e.g., GFR, FRM and CAIA) is a plus

SD-26150-POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCHER IN CARBON FIBRE SURFACE ENGINEERING AND COMPOSITE MANUFACTURING
Fixed term contract | Hautcharage | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

You will be mainly in charge of:

·        Developing and optimising carbon fibre recovery and recycling processes, with a focus on preserving fibre quality and length.
·        Investigating and optimising fibre surface treatments and sizing strategies to improve fibre–matrix compatibility and interfacial performance.
·        Developing fibre alignment strategies and semi-finished products based on recovered carbon fibres.
·        Manufacturing and optimising recycled carbon fibre composite materials and components using suitable processing routes.
·        Performing mechanical and microstructural characterisation and evaluating structure–process–property relationships.
·        Contributing to the manufacturing and validation of composite demonstrators.
·        Analysing and communicating research results through technical reports, scientific publications and presentations.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education

·        PhD in Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Polymer/Composite Engineering or a closely related field.
·        A strong research background in composite materials, preferably involving surface engineering, carbon-fibre-reinforced polymers and/or recycling.

Experience and skills

·        Strong background in fibre-reinforced polymer composites and composite manufacturing.
·        Experience in carbon fibre recycling, surface treatment and/or sizing.
·        Experience in composite processing and mechanical/material characterisation.
·        Knowledge of fibre alignment and semi-finished product manufacturing would be an asset.
·        Ability to independently plan, conduct and analyse experimental research.
·        Strong communication, scientific writing and teamwork skills.

Language skills

•              Fluency in English, oral and written. Other relevant languages are an asset.

Your LIST benefits

·        An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
·        Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society

·        An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas

Apply online

title: Head of International Markets (m/f)
description:
Head of International Markets

Permanent contract

At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction - we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our private banking business.

What you will do:

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer Luxembourg, you will define and execute the Bank's international business development and market corridor strategy in Asia, the Middle East, the UK and the US. Working closely with the Business Head and Relationship Managers, you will drive disciplined delivery of Net New Money (NNM) and revenue, while safeguarding segment and book purity and ensuring a consistently strong client experience. You will promote HSBC Private Bank Luxembourg as the Booking Centre of choice for HSBC PB's international clients, seeking diversification in Continental Europe. As a senior member within the Luxembourg Front Office management team, you will also be accountable for governance and risk management processes and provide supervisory oversight of business activities.

In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Own retention and growth of a Luxembourg-based private banking portfolio sourced from key international markets (Asia, Middle East, UK and US).
• Drive deepening across investments, lending and deposits (where applicable), reducing attrition and ensuring appropriate booking governance and book purity for corridor-sourced relationships.
• Run disciplined sales management, including opportunity qualification, pricing/returns focus, and activity standards.
• Establish corridor-to-PBLU portfolio routines (pipeline, attrition watchlist, top-client plans, rebooking/booking exception management).
• Define, refresh and execute the International Markets strategy in close partnership with the Business Heads, including priority client segments, target industries, and value propositions.
• Build and execute PBLU awareness and adoption plan through structured engagement programmes (education series, immersion and exchange visits, regular follow-ups) to deepen understanding of PBLU's platform, offering and capabilities across other HSBC Private Bank booking centres and relevant HSBC lines of business.
• Deliver market financial targets (revenue, margin, profitability, cost-to-serve where applicable), monitor performance drivers (mix, pricing, attrition, productivity), and ensure transparent forecasting by high-quality management information.

You should apply if you have:

• Extensive experience in Private Banking Relationship Management and senior client-facing roles.
• Positive track record in business development and risk management.
• Strong, up-to-date understanding of the market landscape, peer product offering and industry innovation.
• Experience working with clients and teams across Asia, MENA, the UK and the US.
• Demonstrated ability to shape market strategy and multi-year business plans, including footprint/capability design and target setting.
• Strong commercial execution skills, including pipeline management, conversion discipline, pricing/returns focus.
• Strong stakeholder management skills across products, operations, risk, compliance and multiple geographies.
• Fluent English (written and spoken).

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.

What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is EUR 155,700 - 233,600.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Fluency in English is essential for all roles in Europe and local language skills are highly desirable for some positions, but are not essential for every role.

At Amazon, we are excited to offer MBA candidates the opportunity to launch into big careers with limitless possibilities. We know searching for a full-time role is as much about finding a company where you can picture yourself being successful as it is about finding the right role. We look forward to meeting you and your classmates this year. As we get to know you more, we invite you to get to know us better.
Visit www.amazon.com/about to learn more about...

• Our businesses by reviewing Press Releases on our Investor Relations site, CEO Andy Jassy's 2022 Letter to Shareholders, and the first letter shared in 1997, which is included in our annual report each year
• Amazonians - and follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn
• Our commitment to our communities, diversity and military veterans
• Our European offices, our headquarters in Seattle, as well as where we operate around the world

Important Notes

• You will have the opportunity to specify location and business preference when you create your candidate profile and submit your application within the Amazon portal.
• You need only to submit one Amazon job application for all roles listed below (please use your school e-mail).
• We are looking for candidates who want to own, build and impact the customer experience over being tied to a specific role or team. The role and team placement will be based on business needs and as Amazon continues to grow we cannot guarantee that you will be based in the location or business area of your choice, but we will do our best to take your preferences into account.
• Make sure to list your MBA program and expected conferral date (month and year) within the Education section of your online application and on your resume.
• A cover letter is not necessary.

Key job responsibilities

Launch, Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe, recruits top MBA international talent and builds broad, adaptable Amazonians across corporate businesses in Europe. The program provides a platform for MBAs to make the successful transition from their pre-MBA experience to Amazon. We run a three-year program offering two job rotations supported through on-boarding activities, core training modules, networking opportunities, and mentorship. Launch MBAs start by diving deep to understand customers and how the business is meeting their needs, then apply the learning from their MBA and their own creativity to identify the opportunities where they can make the biggest difference. At the end of the three-year program, MBAs have integrated into Amazon's peculiar ways and have acquired a diverse set of experiences that enable them to take ownership of their next career move through Amazon's extensive internal job opportunities. Through the rotation process, MBAs are able to move to a new function, business, and/or European location.

A day in the life

Opportunities within different business areas vary each year, and can include: Advertising, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Prime Video, Consumer and Devices/Alexa.

Example full-time job functions include:

• Sr. Business Development Manager: Partners with business leaders to grow the business by creating new partnerships, leveraging existing relationships, and/or licensing assets to drive product improvements and innovation, enable distribution of our application, products and/or services, and reduce costs without sacrificing the customer experience.
• Sr. Category Merchant Manager: Manage the portfolio of third-party merchant accounts, support revenue growth and traffic, conduct regular intensive business analysis and reporting, and support the development of the Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) program, and manage projects working with our technology teams to build an extraordinary customer experience.
• Sr. Instock Manager: Develop and execute inventory management strategies (including forecasting, capacity planning, and supply chain optimization), determine how to allocate resources for variable cost reduction and profit margin improvement to drive overall profitability for the business unit.
• Sr. Marketing Manager: Develop and execute strategies for growing the size and lifetime value of the business unit's customer base, through both acquisition and CRM strategies for targeting and communicating with customers.
• Sr. Product Manager: Support the definition and launch of new products, services, or features in partnership with technical teams. Evaluate the existing experience(s) for customers on and off Amazon, identify areas for improvement, develop business requirements, craft and implement marketing plans, and own measures of success.
• Sr. Program Manager: Find solutions to complex problems and innovate on leading edge solutions to manage programs broadly across businesses within Amazon. Given responsibility to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Drive efforts independently and as part of larger project teams, and have a significant impact on the customer experience and the business.
• Sr. Vendor Manager: Identify new brand and product business opportunities, manage relationships with key vendors, negotiate competitive business terms, and secure participation in promotions and marketing programs.

Basic Qualifications

• Graduating between December 1, 2025 and September 30, 2026
• 3+ years of full-time industry work experience, which occurred between the conferral date from your undergraduate program and prior to starting your MBA, OR 3+ years of military work experience prior to starting your MBA program

Preferred Qualifications

• 4+ years of full-time industry/military work experience prior to your MBA
• Fluency in a European language (e.g., German, French, Italian, Spanish)
• Demonstration of interest in the technology industry, such as: Undergraduate/Master's degree in computer science or engineering; prior work experience in a start-up or technology company; SQL or programming experience, etc.
• Experience in sales or account management
• Demonstrated capability of both high-level strategic thinking and detailed execution
• Consistent track record of taking ownership and driving results

title: Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (h/f)
description:
Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F) – Région Liège-Luxembourg

Reference: LU879641
Luxembourg
Permanent
Legal and Professional Services

Notre client est un cabinet de conseil international fondé au début des années 2000 et aujourd'hui présent dans plusieurs pays européens.
Sa mission est d'accompagner les entreprises dans l'atteinte de leurs objectifs en délivrant des résultats mesurables et concrets.
Son expertise couvre l'excellence opérationnelle, l'optimisation de la supply chain, la data, la conduite du changement, la transformation digitale et la transition durable.

Le cabinet intervient auprès d'organisations de premier plan dans des secteurs variés tels que l'industrie, les sciences de la vie, le secteur public, les services financiers, le retail et la construction.
Dans un contexte où les transformations numériques s'accélèrent et où les DSI, CIO et CTO jouent un rôle croissant dans la définition de la stratégie des entreprises, notre client souhaite aujourd'hui franchir une nouvelle étape avec la création et le développement d'une practice CIO Advisory.

Cette practice a vocation à devenir un axe majeur du développement du cabinet, en accompagnant les dirigeants IT et les directions générales dans leurs réflexions et transformations stratégiques, organisationnelles et technologiques.
Pour accompagner sa croissance et participer à des projets de transformation et d'excellence opérationnelle, notre client recherche actuellement un(e) Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F).

Votre rôle

En tant que Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory, vous aurez la responsabilité de piloter et délivrer des missions de transformation IT à fort impact, tout en contribuant au développement de la practice, de son portefeuille clients et de ses équipes.
Vous interviendrez directement auprès des CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, de la définition des orientations jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre, avec une forte exigence de résultats, de qualité de delivery et d'impact durable.

Pilotage et delivery des missions clients

Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conduite et la réussite des missions de la practice :

• Piloter des missions complexes de stratégie et transformation IT, de leur cadrage jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre.
• Accompagner les clients dans la définition de leur vision cible IT et sa déclinaison en feuilles de route concrètes et opérationnelles.
• Superviser les diagnostics, analyses, recommandations et plans de transformation réalisés par les équipes.
• Challenger les organisations, processus, architectures et modes de fonctionnement IT afin d'identifier les leviers de performance et de transformation.
• Assurer la qualité des livrables, le respect des engagements et l'atteinte des résultats attendus.
• Intervenir directement auprès des instances de direction et accompagner les clients dans leurs décisions stratégiques.
• Sécuriser l'exécution des transformations et accompagner les équipes clients jusqu'à l'obtention de résultats durables.
Développement et structuration de la practice

En vous appuyant sur les besoins rencontrés sur le terrain, vous contribuerez à faire évoluer et structurer l'offre CIO Advisory :

• Développer des méthodologies et approches permettant de transformer l'expertise acquise en mission en offres structurées et réplicables.
• Identifier les nouvelles problématiques rencontrées par les CIO et faire évoluer l'offre en conséquence.
• Développer des synergies avec les autres expertises du cabinet : cybersécurité, data, ERP, cloud, transformation et excellence opérationnelle.
• Contribuer au positionnement et au développement de la practice au sein de mon client.
Développement commercial et relation client
Le développement commercial s'inscrira dans la continuité de votre activité de conseil et de votre proximité avec les clients :
• Développer des relations de confiance durables avec les CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales.
• Identifier de nouvelles opportunités à partir des enjeux et besoins rencontrés chez les clients.
• Construire et développer un portefeuille de missions CIO Advisory.
• Piloter les avant-ventes, propositions commerciales, appels d'offres et soutenances.
• Développer le cross-selling avec les autres practices et contribuer à la croissance du cabinet.

Leadership et développement des équipes

En tant que Directeur, vous serez également responsable de la qualité et du développement des équipes intervenant sur vos missions :

• Encadrer les équipes et leur apporter le niveau de guidance nécessaire à la réussite des missions.
• Challenger les analyses, recommandations et livrables afin de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence.
• Accompagner les consultants dans leur montée en compétences et leur capacité à prendre progressivement davantage de responsabilités en delivery.
• Transmettre votre expertise à travers le coaching, le mentoring et le partage d'expérience.
• Contribuer au recrutement et au développement des expertises nécessaires à la croissance de la practice.
• Développer une culture fondée sur l'excellence du delivery, le pragmatisme, la collaboration et l'obtention de résultats concrets.

Profil recherché

Nous recherchons avant tout un leader entrepreneurial, capable de combiner expertise technique, excellence du delivery et développement commercial.

Vous disposez idéalement de :

• Une formation de niveau Master (Bac+5), idéalement issue d'une école d'ingénieurs, d'une université ou d'une grande école avec une spécialisation IT, digitale ou technologique.
• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans le conseil, la transformation IT ou des environnements technologiques complexes.
• De solides compétences techniques et une forte compréhension des enjeux IT, vous permettant de challenger des architectures, des organisations, des choix technologiques et des trajectoires de transformation.
• Une expertise sur plusieurs dimensions du CIO Advisory : stratégie IT, operating model, cloud, infrastructures, architecture, cybersécurité, data, modernisation ou rationalisation des systèmes d'information.
• Une expérience significative dans le pilotage et le delivery de missions complexes, depuis le cadrage stratégique jusqu'à la mise en œuvre.
• Une expérience solide auprès de CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, avec la capacité à intervenir comme interlocuteur de confiance sur des problématiques stratégiques et techniques.
• Une réelle capacité à développer du business : identification d'opportunités, développement de comptes, construction de propositions commerciales, soutenances et développement de nouvelles missions.
• Une forte capacité à développer et entretenir des relations de confiance avec des décideurs de haut niveau.
• Un fort esprit entrepreneurial, avec l'envie de construire, structurer et faire grandir une activité.
• Une excellente communication, une forte posture de conseil et une capacité à embarquer clients et équipes.

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). title: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems (m/f)
description:
Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems

Position: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg
Start Date: Immediate
Type: Full-time

Company Overview

We're LuxQuantum, a Luxembourg-based deep-tech startup developing the next generation of quantum-safe communication systems.

Our mission is to address one of the key challenges in modern cybersecurity: how to combine Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) into a unified, adaptive, and scalable security architecture.

At LuxQuantum, we believe security decisions should not be static. Different data, infrastructures, risks, trust assumptions, and operational conditions may require different protection strategies. That's why we are developing intelligent and adaptive approaches to model these complex environments and support dynamic security and orchestration decisions.

Our work brings together AI, systems modeling, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications, creating research challenges that span multiple scientific and engineering disciplines.

We are a small and ambitious team of researchers, engineers, and innovators who enjoy exploring difficult problems, learning across disciplines, and turning research ideas into real-world technology.

Role Overview

As a Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer, you will contribute to the research and development of the intelligence and decision-making capabilities behind LuxQuantum's adaptive quantum-safe security systems.

You will investigate how complex security and communication systems can adapt to changing risks, uncertainty, trust requirements, infrastructure conditions, and operational constraints. Your work may involve mathematical and computational modeling, optimization, probabilistic methods, AI, or other data-driven and decision-support approaches.

You will work closely with our research and engineering team to formulate research problems, explore and compare different approaches, develop models and algorithms, evaluate them through experiments and simulations, and translate promising results into working prototypes.

The research sits at the intersection of systems modeling, intelligent decision-making, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications.

What You'll Do

• Investigate challenging research problems in intelligent and adaptive security systems
• Formulate research questions, develop new approaches, and design experiments and simulations to evaluate them
• Develop mathematical, computational, and AI-based models for decision-making under uncertainty, risk, and changing operational conditions
• Explore adaptive approaches for the orchestration and optimization of hybrid quantum-safe systems
• Design and evaluate methods that help security systems dynamically respond to changing infrastructure, trust, and operational requirements
• Translate research ideas, models, and algorithms into working prototypes and validate them in realistic scenarios
• Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers across software, AI, cybersecurity, and quantum technologies
• Contribute to the technical direction, architecture, and documentation of LuxQuantum's research and development activities

What We're Looking For

• PhD in a quantitative, scientific, engineering, or computing-related field; or a Master's degree with strong relevant research or R&D experience
• Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capacity to investigate complex problems, develop new approaches, and evaluate them systematically
• Experience with quantitative, computational, modeling, optimization, AI/ML, or related research methods
• Good programming and computational skills in one or more languages such as Python, C++, Rust, or similar
• Ability to translate research ideas, mathematical models, or algorithms into working prototypes
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a small multidisciplinary team
• Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn and work across different technical domains
• Understanding of startup environments and research-driven innovation
• Fluent written and verbal communication in English

We welcome candidates from different scientific, engineering, and computational backgrounds, including PhD graduates, postdoctoral researchers, and researchers interested in transitioning from academia to industrial R&D. Prior experience in quantum technologies or quantum-safe cybersecurity is welcome but not required.

Nice to Have

Experience in any of the following is a plus, but not required:

• Cybersecurity, risk modeling, or security-related systems
• Quantum technologies, Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), or Quantum Key Distribution (QKD)
• Complex or distributed systems, simulation, or system orchestration
• Research software development and building experimental prototypes
• APIs, containerization, or ML/MLOps tools such as Docker, FastAPI, MLflow, or similar

Who You Are

• Curious and motivated by difficult problems where the answer is not always known in advance
• An independent thinker who enjoys exploring, testing, and improving new ideas
• Interested in turning research and theory into working systems with real-world impact
• Comfortable taking ownership while collaborating closely with a small multidisciplinary team
• Open to learning across disciplines and applying your expertise to new technical challenges
• Excited by the pace, responsibility, and opportunity to shape technology in an early-stage
deep-tech startup

Why Join LuxQuantum

Research with Real-World Impact

Work on challenging R&D problems and help turn research ideas, models, and algorithms into technologies for next-generation secure communication systems.

High Ownership

Take meaningful ownership of your work and have the opportunity to influence technical decisions and the direction of LuxQuantum's technology.

Work Across Disciplines

Collaborate at the intersection of systems modeling, AI, cybersecurity, software engineering, and quantum-safe communications, with the opportunity to expand your expertise into new areas.

Grow with a Deep-Tech Startup

Join LuxQuantum at an early stage, with the autonomy to explore ideas, take responsibility, and contribute to the development of both our technology and our research-driven engineering culture.

How to Apply

Please send:

• Your CV
• A short cover letter describing your background, relevant research or technical experience, and interest in the role
• Links to relevant projects, technical work, GitHub, or other examples of your work, if available (optional)

to:

contact@luxquantum.lu

Join us in building intelligent, adaptive security systems for the future of quantum-safe communications.

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.

You will work across a diverse portfolio of clients spanning Financial Services, the Public Sector, and the Private Sector. Operate as a hands on engineer within a squad, taking ownership of defined components and delivering AI capabilities (e.g., agents, RAG pipelines) that meet enterprise standards for reliability, security and observability. Client facing engineering & delivery

Solution design & implementation

Product mindset & continuous improvement

• Strong Python/TypeScript; async patterns; API design; testing/CI; microservice fundamentals.

• Cloud engineering (Azure preferred), Docker/Kubernetes, serverless; secure networking/IAM.
• Data engineering fundamentals (Spark/Databricks; ETL/ELT) and operational handover.
• Consulting behaviors: stakeholder engagement and clear, client ready communication.
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar role.
• Fluent written and spoken English, French/German is a plus.

Ideally, you'll also

• Document/graph stores; streaming (Event Hub/Kafka); cloud architecture exposure and governance credentials.

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Your future team

The PMO Manager - Tax will support the planning, coordination, and delivery of the internal tax projects. The PMO Manager is responsible for establishing and maintaining structured project management, governance and reporting for tax initiatives, while navigating a diverse and complex stakeholder environment (Quality and Risk Management, IT, Operations, Business, and Sub-Service Lines).
The PMO Manager will act as a central coordination point, helping tax leadership translate strategic objectives into prioritized projects, tracking delivery against commitments, and supporting decision-making through high-quality analysis and communication.

The advantages of joining us

1.    Global impact, local connections: Work on international projects and collaborate with diverse teams, all while making an impact locally.
2.    Purpose-driven work: Get involved in sustainability initiatives and community service, making a real difference while growing your career.
3.    Build your network: Gain access to our global network of professionals and notable alumni and attend industry events to connect and grow your professional circle.
4.    Career growth, your way: Access top-notch training and career development, with a clear progression path to help you level up at your own pace.
5.    Innovative work that matters: Tackle cutting-edge projects and utilize the latest tech, with all the tools you need to stay ahead.

How you'll contribute to our success

1.    Support the design and ongoing management of the tax projects (e.g., compliance, reporting, data, technology, processes, etc) and drive consistent project lifecycle management from initiation to closure.
2.    Support the prioritization and sequencing of tax initiatives, balancing regulatory deadlines, business needs, capacity and budget constraints.
3.    Support tax leadership in operating a robust governance framework: steering committees, working groups, and decision forums.
4.    Prepare high-quality, concise materials for steering committees, senior management, and other governance forums (status updates, dashboards, decision papers).
5.    Operate as a central point of contact and coordination between Tax, Finance, IT, HR, Legal, Operations, Shared Services and external advisors for transformation initiatives.
6.    Facilitate alignment across stakeholders, proactively resolving conflicts, clarifying responsibilities, and addressing competing priorities.  
7.    Track and challenge assumptions that may impact project outcomes, timelines, or benefits, especially where multiple stakeholder groups are involved.
8.    Collaborate with Tax, HR, and other stakeholders to develop training, communications, and change plans to support adoption of new tax processes, systems, or regulatory requirements.  
9.    Support lessons-learned reviews and embed improvements into future tax projects and PMO practices.

Your skills

Must Have

1.    Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Tax, or a related field (or equivalent experience).  
2.    Proven experience in a PMO, project, or program management role. Ideally hold a professional qualifications in project management (e.g., PMP, Prince2, Agile/Scrum) or demonstrable equivalent experience.
3.    Demonstrated ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments with multiple senior leaders, and functions.  
4.    Strong stakeholder management, influencing and negotiation skills; comfortable challenging and engaging senior stakeholders.  
5.    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, actionable insights.  
6.    Excellent communication skills (written and verbal), including preparation of concise, high-impact presentations and dashboards for leadership.  
7.    Strong command of common PMO and productivity tools (e.g., Excel, PowerPoint, project/portfolio tools such as MS Project, Planner, JIRA, or similar).

Nice to Have

1.    Experience working within Big 4/consulting environment, or a complex multinational organization is a plus.
2.    Professional qualifications in project management (e.g., PMP, Prince2, Agile/Scrum) or demonstrable equivalent experience.  
3.    Experience supporting transformation or change programs with significant technology, data, or process components.
4.    Resilient, calm under pressure, and comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.  
5.    Curious and eager to understand both tax technical and business drivers to support more effective decision-making.

• Our European offices, our headquarters in Seattle, as well as where we operate around the world

Important Notes

• You will have the opportunity to specify location and business preference when you create your candidate profile and submit your application within the Amazon portal.
• You need only to submit one Amazon job application for all roles listed below (please use your school e-mail).

The role and team placement will be based on business needs and as Amazon continues to grow we cannot guarantee that you will be based in the location or business area of your choice, but we will do our best to take your preferences into account.

Key job responsibilities

Launch, Amazon's corporate MBA program for Europe, recruits top MBA international talent and builds broad, adaptable Amazonians across corporate businesses in Europe. The program provides a platform for MBAs to make the successful transition from their pre-MBA experience to Amazon. We run a three-year program offering two job rotations supported through on-boarding activities, core training modules, networking opportunities, and mentorship. Launch MBAs start by diving deep to understand customers and how the business is meeting their needs, then apply the learning from their MBA and their own creativity to identify the opportunities where they can make the biggest difference. At the end of the three-year program, MBAs have integrated into Amazon's peculiar ways and have acquired a diverse set of experiences that enable them to take ownership of their next career move through Amazon's extensive internal job opportunities. Through the rotation process, MBAs are able to move to a new function, business, and/or European location.

A day in the life

Opportunities within different business areas vary each year, and can include: Advertising, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Amazon Prime Video, Consumer and Devices/Alexa.

Example full-time job functions include:

• Sr. Marketing Manager: Develop and execute strategies for growing the size and lifetime value of the business unit's customer base, through both acquisition and CRM strategies for targeting and communicating with customers.
• Sr. Product Manager: Support the definition and launch of new products, services, or features in partnership with technical teams. Evaluate the existing experience(s) for customers on and off Amazon, identify areas for improvement, develop business requirements, craft and implement marketing plans, and own measures of success.
• Sr. Program Manager: Find solutions to complex problems and innovate on leading edge solutions to manage programs broadly across businesses within Amazon. Given responsibility to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Drive efforts independently and as part of larger project teams, and have a significant impact on the customer experience and the business.
• Sr. Vendor Manager: Identify new brand and product business opportunities, manage relationships with key vendors, negotiate competitive business terms, and secure participation in promotions and marketing programs.

• Graduating between December 1, 2025 and September 30, 2026
• 3+ years of full-time industry work experience, which occurred between the conferral date from your undergraduate program and prior to starting your MBA, OR 3+ years of military work experience prior to starting your MBA program

Preferred Qualifications

title: Executive Assistant & Business Management Support - CEO Office (m/f)
description:
Description:


Executive Assistant


Pour l'un de nos clients, acteur bancaire de premier plan au Luxembourg, nous recherchons un(e) Executive Assistant & Business Management Support pour rejoindre l'environnement direct du CEO et de son Executive Office.


A PROPOS DU POSTE

Vous avez déjà acquis une première expérience solide dans un environnement exigeant, idéalement au sein d'un Big4, d'un cabinet de conseil, d'un cabinet d'avocats ou du secteur financier, et vous souhaitez aujourd'hui vous rapprocher du cœur des décisions d'une organisation ?

Cette opportunité va au-delà d'un poste classique d'Executive Assistant.

Aux côtés du CEO et de son environnement exécutif, vous combinez support de haut niveau, coordination, préparation de supports et suivi de sujets stratégiques et opérationnels.

Votre rôle : permettre au CEO d'être organisé, préparé et concentré sur ses priorités, tout en assurant un suivi rigoureux des informations, demandes et actions qui gravitent autour de l'Executive Office.

Il s'agit d'une fonction particulièrement intéressante pour un profil ayant environ 5 années d'expérience, souhaitant continuer à apprendre, gagner en exposition et évoluer progressivement vers des responsabilités plus larges de Business Management / Executive Office.


VOTRE RÔLE ET RESPONSABILITES:
Executive Support & organisation

Vous assurez un support quotidien fluide et structuré auprès du CEO et de son environnement exécutif :

    gestion proactive d'un agenda complexe et mouvant ;
    organisation et coordination des réunions internes et externes ;
    préparation des rendez-vous, agendas et documents nécessaires ;
    anticipation des échéances et identification des priorités ;
    coordination des déplacements professionnels et de leur logistique ;
    gestion des notes de frais, factures et autres sujets administratifs associés.

Vous ne vous contentez pas d'organiser : vous anticipez, identifiez les conflits de priorité et proposez des solutions.
Business Management & coordination

Une partie importante de votre rôle consiste à faciliter le fonctionnement de l'Executive Office.

À ce titre, vous :

    assurez le suivi des actions et décisions prises lors des réunions ;
    sollicitez les différentes parties prenantes afin d'obtenir les informations attendues ;
    consolidez des informations provenant de plusieurs interlocuteurs ;
    structurez ces éléments afin de les rendre immédiatement exploitables par le CEO ;
    maintenez des trackers et outils de suivi permettant de donner de la visibilité sur l'avancement des différents sujets ;
    contribuez à la coordination de projets et initiatives transverses ;
    identifiez les échéances ou sujets nécessitant une attention particulière et les faites remonter de manière proactive.

Votre capacité à comprendre rapidement un sujet, structurer l'information et assurer le suivi jusqu'à sa finalisation fera réellement la différence.
Executive Communication & préparation de supports

Vous contribuez directement à la qualité des informations et documents utilisés au niveau exécutif :

    préparation et mise en forme de présentations PowerPoint ;
    préparation de briefings, notes de synthèse et meeting packs ;
    consolidation de données et préparation de reportings simples sous Excel ;
    rédaction, relecture et adaptation de communications en français et en anglais ;
    préparation et organisation de documents destinés à des réunions de management ou de gouvernance.

Vous savez transformer une quantité importante d'informations en un support clair, synthétique et orienté décision.
Coordination & stakeholder management

Positionné(e) au cœur de l'organisation, vous êtes en interaction avec de nombreux interlocuteurs internes et externes.

Vous assurez une communication fluide et professionnelle, relancez lorsque nécessaire et savez adapter votre approche à des interlocuteurs de niveaux de séniorité différents.

La confidentialité, la diplomatie et la qualité de votre communication sont essentielles dans cette fonction.


Vous avez idéalement :

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. How will you contribute?

We are looking for a skilled and hands-on VR User Interface Developer to join a short-term research and development project. The successful candidate will design and implement an immersive user interface running on a VR headset and connect it to a robot digital twin. The interface will enable users to visualise the robot, access relevant operational information, and interact with the digital-twin environment in an intuitive and reliable way. The role combines virtual-reality development, user-interface engineering, 3D interaction design, and integration with robotics or simulation software.

Key tasks:

·       Designing and developing an immersive user interface for a VR headset.
·      Implementing intuitive 3D interactions, menus, dashboards, status indicators, controls, and notifications.
·      Integrating the VR interface with a robot digital twin and its underlying simulation or robotics platform.
·       Visualising relevant robot and system information, such as robot position, operating mode, sensor data, alerts, and task progress.
·       Supporting user interaction with the robot digital twin, including monitoring, exploration, and, where applicable, control functionalities.
·       Developing the application using a suitable real-time 3D engine, such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
·       Testing and optimising the interface on the target VR headset, with particular attention to usability, reliability, and performance.
·       Collaborating with researchers, robotics engineers, software developers, and user-experience specialists.
·       Maintaining the source code and preparing technical documentation covering the architecture, installation, configuration, and integration procedures.
·       Delivering a functional and demonstrable prototype within the three-month assignment.

·          University degree or equivalent professional experience in computer science, software engineering, game development, robotics, human-computer interaction, or a related field.
·          Knowledge of software development, 3D visualisation, virtual reality, and user-interface design.
