title: SAP Integration Consultant
description:
Vi söker en SAP Integration Consultant som ser integration som mer än att flytta data från A till B. Du vill förstå vad som händer före och efter gränssnittet och bygga lösningar som fungerar även när processer, system och krav förändras.

Du gillar tekniken och kan gå på djupet när det behövs, men vet också att en bra integration börjar med rätt problem. Hos oss arbetar du nära både kunden och tekniken, från felsökning av affärskritiska flöden till design av nya integrationer och framtida integrationslandskap.

Vad du kommer att göra

Du kommer bland annat att:

    designa, bygga och förvalta integrationer i SAP-landskap, ofta med SAP S/4HANA i centrum
    arbeta med SAP Integration Suite, CPI och BTP, och ibland även äldre miljöer som SAP PI/PO
    bygga integrationer med API:er, OData, REST, SOAP, IDoc, EDI och eventdrivna mönster
    koppla ihop SAP med andra affärssystem, molnplattformar, SaaS-tjänster och externa partners
    arbeta med integrationsarkitektur och bidra i S/4HANA-transformationer där data, processer och system behöver fungera tillsammans
    ta ansvar från behov och design till utveckling, test, driftsättning, felsökning och förvaltning
    samarbeta med verksamhet, arkitekter och utvecklingsteam och utmana gamla arbetssätt när det finns ett enklare eller smartare sätt

Vem vi tror att du är

Du har minst fyra års relevant erfarenhet och en stabil grund inom SAP-integration. Du känner dig trygg i att självständigt ta dig an integrationsfrågor och kan röra dig mellan verksamhet och teknik.

Exakt vilka tekniker du har arbetat mest med är mindre viktigt än att du förstår integration som helhet, kan sätta dig in i nya miljöer och tar ansvar för att lösningen faktiskt fungerar.

Vi tror också att du:

    har praktisk erfarenhet av SAP-integration och minst en integrationsplattform eller integrationsstack
    förstår API:er, integrationsmönster, dataformat och hur system kommunicerar med varandra
    har arbetat kundnära och kan översätta mellan verksamhet och teknik
    driver saker framåt utan att behöva bli detaljstyrd
    är pragmatisk och gillar att lösa riktiga problem, inte bara följa en kravlista
    har börjat använda AI som ett naturligt verktyg i ditt arbete och är nyfiken på hur det kan skapa mer nytta för kunden
    delar med dig av det du kan och tycker om att bygga tillsammans med andra
    kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av SAP S/4HANA, SAP Integration Suite, BTP, API Management, Azure, EDI, integrationsarkitektur eller större transformations- och implementationsprojekt. Erfarenhet av CI/CD, eventdriven integration eller Clean Core är också ett plus.

Du behöver inte kunna allt. Det viktiga är att du har en stabil grund, ett eget driv och vill fortsätta utvecklas.

Varför Norrminds?

Du börjar inte på Norrminds bara för att få ett nytt jobb.

Vi bygger ett bolag där människor med olika styrkor får stort ansvar, kan påverka hur vi arbetar och hjälper varandra att bli bättre. Vi tror på modet att testa gränser, på att göra saker tillsammans och på att teknik ska skapa nytta, inte bara mer teknik.

Vi arbetar i gränslandet mellan affärssystem, integration, AI och automation. Det betyder att du får möjlighet att både fördjupa dig inom SAP och bredda dig när det finns ett problem som är värt att lösa.

Rollen kan utgå från Malmö, Linköping eller Stockholm. I dessa städer vill vi bygga något långsiktigt, så du ska tycka om tanken på att vara nära både kunder och framtida kollegor och vara med och forma Norrminds lokalt.

Känner du igen dig? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig.

title: Lärare grundskolan - Spanska och ytterligare ett ämne
description:
Kunskapsskolan i Sverige, där även Kunskapsgymnasiet ingår, startade sina första skolor år 2000 och har idag 29 grundskolor och sex gymnasier med 1 350 medarbetare och 13 000 elever. Kunskapsskolan ägs av grundaren Peje Emilsson med familj.

Kunskapsskolan Kropkslätt söker en legitimerad lärare i Spanska och ytterligare ett ämne för årskurs 7-9.

Vill du arbeta i en skola där varje elev ges något unikt – en personligt utformad utbildning – som utgår från elevens individuella mål och förutsättningar? Då har vi jobbet för dig!

På Kunskapsskolan har vi en pedagogik som är personligt utformad och utgår från varje individ. Genom vårt arbetssätt skapar vi nära relationer mellan lärare och elev, vilket ger förutsättningar för att varje elev ska nå längre än de själva tror är möjligt. I en miljö där eleven får vara sig själv och får rätt stöd och utmaningar skapar vi en skola där både elever och medarbetare trivs och utvecklas.

Kunskapsskolan Krokslätt är en grundskola för årskurs 4-9 och har idag cirka 270 elever. Skolan startade 2010 och ligger vid knytpunkten Lana. Skolan är belägen i ett expansivt område där många spännande projekt från Göteborgs Stad planeras.

Skolan har under flera år visat upp en hög nöjdhet från både vårdnadshavare, elever och medarbetare samt en väldigt hög lärarbehörighet. Vi har även under flera år även haft ett positivt SALSA-värde.

För att varje elev ska nå så långt som möjligt behövs yrkesskickliga lärare med ett stort engagemang för eleven. På Kunskapsskolan sätter vi alltid individen i centrum och söker därför dig som alltid arbetar aktivt för att dina elever ska lyckas.

På Kunskapsskolan har vi ett utpräglat lagarbete. Du är aldrig ensam med utmaningar och frågeställningar. Vi hjälps åt att planera arbetet i arbets- och i ämneslag. Öppenheten mellan lärare är stor och vi har ett gemensamt ansvar för våra elever.

För att underlätta för dig i ditt arbete och möjliggöra för dig att fokusera din tid på eleverna har vi samlat en stor del av våra läromedel på vår digitala portal Kunskapsporten. För varje ämne finns förslag på arbetssätt, uppgifter och läromedel.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker legitimerad lärare i Spanska i kombination med ytterligare ett ämne för årskurs 7-9. Du ska vara väl förtrogen med LGR-22 och formativ bedömning.

Meriterande kvalifikationer

Vi ser gärna att du har några års erfarenhet av undervisning och handledning eller mentorskap. Vi vill att du har lätt för att samarbeta med kollegor, elever och vårdnadshavare och är lösningsfokuserad.

Vi sätter stort värde vid ditt engagemang, din pedagogiska kompetens och din handledarförmåga. Vi vill att du ska vara en stabil och trygg person som kan skapa förtroende hos eleverna.

Tjänstens utformning



Tjänsten är en tillsvidaretjänst på 100%

Rekryteringsprocessen



Ansökan sker via länken nedan senast den 12/11 2026. Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

För att arbeta i skola krävs utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Blankett finns på Rikspolisstyrelsens webbplats.

Vid frågor kontakta rektor Emil Dolk på emil.dolk@kunskapsskolan.se eller via telefon 0733 - 17 34 42.

Mer information om oss och vår pedagogik hittar du på vår hemsida, http://www.kunskapsskolan.se / https://www.kunskapsgymnasiet.se/



Säljare av rekryteringstjänster gör sig icke besvär.

description:
Aeternum Holding AB är förvaltningsbolag till Wonna I de Jong Fastigheter.

Wonna I de Jong är en privat fastighetsägare med ca 1800 lägenheter och 2000 kommersiella hyresgäster. Vår policy är att äga, förädla och förvalta fastigheter långsiktigt. Vi vill att våra hyresgäster skall känna sig nöjda och trygga i sin arbets- och boendemiljö. Vi strävar efter att höja standarden på våra fastigheter och erbjuder kvalité till våra hyresgäster, och att skapa sunda och familjevänliga boendemiljöer.

Vi söker en duktig, noggrann och ambitiös fastighetsskötare för vårt fastighetsbestånd i Malmköping

Du gillar att ta ansvar och är självgående, lojal och långsiktig. Du ska vara social och ha ett bra bemötande mot dina arbetskamrater och kunder.

Du är villig att lära Dig nya saker, gillar utmaningar och tekniska lösningar.

Krav:

- Erfarenhet och intresse i bygg branschen och fastighetsskötsel.

-Körkort

-behärskar svenska i tal och skrift

Arbetsuppgifter

I arbetsuppgifterna ingår daglig rondering och ansvar för utemiljö, lekplatser, parkeringar, gemensamma områden. Allmän tillsyn och kontroll samt identifiera tänkbara problem för hyresgästerna och se till att vidta lämpliga åtgärder. Till exempel se till att värme, ventilation, tvättstugor, bokningssystem, portar, dörrar och andra tekniska system fungerar och bidra till besparande och miljövänliga lösningar. Arbete kräver att Du själv åtgärdar felanmälningar och utför reparationer i lägenheter som snickerier, måleri, felsökningar, mindre vvs och el-arbeten samt reparation av vitvaror. Alla inkomna felanmälningar måste dokumenteras och följas upp konsekvent tillsammans med administrativa avdelningen genom dagliga rapporter.

Viktigt med tillsynsarbetet och förebyggande, så att akuta problem inte uppstå. Om större fel uppkommer kontakta ansvariga på kontoret, för vidare åtgärd till värmetekniker, elektriker eller någon annan specialist.

Du är så välkommen att skicka Din ansökan med CV och personligt brev till oss per e-mail, i fall Du känner att detta är ett arbete för Dig! Vi beklagar att vi inte kommer att bekräfta varje ansökan utan endast de utvalda arbetssökande ska bjudas till intervjuer.

SVARA ENDAST om Du uppfyller alla krav.

title: Söker en duktig Kakelsättare
description:
Vi förvaltar över 1800 hyreslägenheter och 2000 kommersiella enheter i stor Stockholm.

Vi söker en erfaren och flexibel målare  kakelsättare/plattsättare, snickare till vårt lag. Vi utför renoveringar av lägenheter och lokaler efter kunderna och fastighetsägarnas behov.

Vi söker en duktig, noggrann, lojal kakelsättare som är kunnig på våtrums utrymme och dess regler. Men kan även snickeri och måleri.

Vi söker Dig som gillar att ta ansvar och är självgående. Du ska vara social och ha ett bra bemötande mot dina arbetskamrater och kunder.

Vi ser helst att du har bra referenser på plattsättnings arbeten och har jobbat med olika system av tätskikt i våt rumsutrymmen.

Har du snickarkunskaper och måleri kunskaper är det till fördel. Du är arbetsam och kan arbeta både självständigt och i grupp, ska vara flexibel och lojal.

Krav:

- Minst 5 års erfarenhet i fastighetsbranschen/byggbranschen

- Självgående inom fall spackling, tätskikts arbeten, plattsättning

- Kunskap om måleri och snickeri, om allmän byggnation

- God social kompetens, lojal, noggrann med tider

Meriterande:

-Körkort

-behärskar svenska i tal och skrift

-om Du kan andra arbeten inom byggbranschen

Vi erbjuder en fulltids lön med provanställning på 6 månader och tillsvidare anställning därefter.

Svara ENDAST om Du uppfyller alla krav.

title: Säljare - Sängexpert
description:
SOVA söker sängexperter på Kungsgatan – Är du vår nästa stjärna?

SOVA har varit sängexperter sedan 1989. Vi kan kanske inte allt om soffor eller utemöbler, men när det gäller sängar är vi ledande. Nu söker vi dig som vill bli en del av vårt expertteam och hjälpa våra kunder att hitta den perfekta sängen för en bättre natts sömn. Vår vision är att alla människor ska få vakna upp utvilade och fulla av energi, varje dag – och som sängexpert har du en nyckelroll i att göra detta möjligt.

Om rollen som sängexpert:

Som sängexpert på SOVA kommer du att guida våra kunder genom hela processen för att hitta den säng som bäst matchar deras kropp och sovvanor. Genom vår unika SOVA-metod som består av fyra enkla steg – funktion, känsla, design och kvalitet – hjälper du våra kunder att göra en investering i sin sömn. För att säkerställa att kunden får den bästa rekommendationen arbetar du alltid tillsammans med en kollega.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

    Genomföra sängprovningar med våra kunder

    Ge kunden rätt stöd och komfort utifrån deras specifika behov

    Bidra med hög produktkunskap och en passion för sömn och välbefinnande

Vem söker vi?

    Ett genuint intresse för sömn och att förbättra människors välbefinnande

    En vilja att utvecklas och lära dig allt om sängar, deras uppbyggnad och material

    Förmåga att skapa förtroende och ge förstklassig service

    Intresse för ergonomi och produktnördighet

    Erfarenhet av försäljning är ett plus, men inget krav

    Vår kundtillströmning är som störst på helgerna vilket innebär att du kommer arbeta 2 av 3 helger.

Utbildning och utveckling – SOVA-akademin

För att säkerställa att du blir en certifierad sängexpert, genomgår du vårt utbildningsprogram på SOVA-akademin. Här lär du dig allt om sängarnas tekniska specifikationer, materialval och ergonomi. Utbildningen avslutas med ett omfattande kunskapsprov, och vi ser till att du genom regelbundna tester alltid håller din expertis på topp.

Varför välja SOVA?

    Du blir en del av ett engagerat och kunnigt team med stark passion för sömn

    Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats där produktnördighet och kundfokus står i centrum

    Hos oss får du chansen att hjälpa människor till bättre sömn och ökat välmående

Vill du hjälpa människor att vakna utvilade och fulla av energi varje dag?

Ansök redan idag och bli en del av vårt framgångsrika team hos SOVA! Urval och intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Vi ser det som positivt att du genomför alla moment i ansökan, speciellt videofrågorna.

Om detta känns rätt för dig är du varmt välkommen med din ansökan till oss!

title: Säljare Lomex AI
description:
Sälj en produkt branschen faktiskt behöver

﻿Heltid · Distans (arbeta var du vill i Sverige)

Krav: tidigare erfarenhet av försäljning

Byggbranschen är en av Sveriges största, men också en av de sista som digitaliseras på allvar. Varje vecka hålls tusentals byggmöten, där någon ska skriva protokoll, fördela åtgärder och hålla koll på besluten. Det som missas kostar tid och pengar.

Lomex AI ändrar det. Byggmötet spelas in, och några minuter senare finns protokoll, åtgärdslista, riskanalys och vilka regler som berörs. Projektledare kan också ställa frågor om regelverket och få svar med källa på sekunder. Vi bygger plattformen för svenska byggbolag och söker säljare som vill vara med från början.

Om rollen

Du är med i ett tidigt skede och formar hur vi bearbetar marknaden. Du bokar möten och driver affärer från första samtal till signerat avtal, mot byggbolag, projektledningsbolag och tekniska konsulter. Allt sker på distans, och du har nära kontakt med grundarna hela vägen.

Vad vi erbjuder

Det här är en renodlad provisionsroll – med obegränsad uppsida för dig som levererar. Du arbetar på distans och säljer en produkt som är enkel att demonstrera och löser ett verkligt problem. Och du får chansen att vara med tidigt och forma både rollen och bolaget.

Vem vi söker

Du har tidigare arbetat med försäljning och vet hur det är att sälja och stänga affärer, till exempel inom telefonförsäljning, fältförsäljning eller B2B. Du trivs med att arbeta självständigt mot tydliga mål, bygger förtroende hos beslutsfattare och räds inte ett nej – du ser det som information, inte ett stopp. Du är strukturerad, följer upp det du lovar, och kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift.

Ansökan

Skicka ditt CV och några rader om varför du passar för rollen. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande och ser fram emot din ansökan.

title: Vi söker en Senior Kravanalytiker till EDGE Associates (Sundsvall)
description:
🚀 Vi söker en Senior Kravanalytiker till EDGE Associates!

📍 Plats: Distans inom Sverige, Sundsvall minst 4 dagar/månad (ev. mer)

📅 Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-10-19

🌟 Om rollen

Vill du arbeta med kravarbete i absolut framkant och vara med och utveckla samhällsviktiga handläggnings- och stödsystem?

Vi på EDGE Associates söker nu en senior Kravanalytiker till vårt team. Du blir anställd hos oss och kliver direkt in i ett centralt och spännande uppdrag hos en stor statlig myndighet. I denna roll leder du kravarbetet inom ett tvärfunktionellt utvecklingsteam som bygger och förvaltar egenutvecklade applikationer i en modern, händelsebaserad mikrotjänstarkitektur.

Du blir en nyckelperson i att bryta ned verksamhetsbehov till detaljerade tekniska krav, hålla ordning på teamets backlog samt driva pedagogiska workshops och storymapping. Du förväntas även agera mentor för andra i organisationen och vid behov kunna kliver in som Scrum Master.

Huvudsakliga ansvarsområden:

• Leda kravarbetet och upprätta, strukturera och prioritera teamets backlog.

• Bryta ned krav på hög detaljnivå (både backend, frontend och databas) för snabb realisering i agila flöden.

• Arbeta tätt med beställande verksamhet, produktägare, utvecklingsteam och övriga intressenter.

• Ta fram IT-funktionsbeskrivningar, funktionsflöden, acceptanskriterier och felhantering.

• Leda workshops, storymapping och pedagogiskt kommunicera krav till berörda mottagare.

• Stötta framtagandet av processer i Camunda samt coacha och mentora kollegor inom kravmetodik.

🛠️ Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har en stark analytisk förmåga, är kommunikativ och har djup erfarenhet från regelstyrd offentlig verksamhet och komplexa IT-miljöer.

Vi söker dig som har:

✔ Minst 2 års erfarenhet de senaste 5 åren som kravanalytiker inom svensk offentlig verksamhet och lag- och regelstyrd miljö.

✔ Erfarenhet av att utveckla kund- och handläggningssystem för offentliga stöd eller motsvarande (minst 2 år de senaste 5 åren).

✔ Dokumenterad vana av att ta fram tekniska krav för systemutveckling av applikationer och kod.

✔ God förmåga att leda, driva, analysera samt stödja och coacha andra.

✔ Flytande kunskaper i svenska i både tal och skrift (CV ska vara skrivet på svenska).

Det är meriterande om du har:

➕ Minst 5 års erfarenhet som kravanalytiker från större IT-organisationer (+100 anställda) eller statlig myndighet.

➕ Erfarenhet av systemutveckling inom ekonomiska system, offentliga lån, bidrag eller finans.

➕ Stor kunskap om nedbrytning av krav för iterativ utveckling inom Scrum.

➕ Förståelse för plattformar och ramverk baserade på Angular, Java, Spring Boot, OpenShift, Camunda, Rabbit MQ och DB2.

➕ Erfarenhet av system med regelbunden data-gallring.

➕ Mycket goda kunskaper i Jira och Confluence.

💡 Varför EDGE Associates?

Hos oss blir du en del av ett innovativt och teknikorienterat team där vi arbetar med spännande och samhällskritiska projekt. Vi erbjuder:

✅ Fast anställning

✅ Konkurrenskraftig lön där du får merparten av intäkterna du genererar.

✅ Attraktiva förmåner och fokus på din work-life balance.

✅ Utmanande uppdrag via våra över 30 egna direktavtal med stora aktörer inom offentlig och privat sektor.

✅ Stark teamkultur där vi delar kunskap och utvecklas tillsammans.

Vill du leda kravarbetet i ett av Sveriges mest spännande IT-uppdrag?

Skicka in din ansökan idag!

title: Hostel / Hotel Manager
description:
HOSTEL / HOTEL MANAGER

Stockholm, Sweden

We are looking for a hands-on Hostel / Hotel Manager to join our growing hospitality company in central Stockholm. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining team management with the practical, day-to-day operation of a hostel.

Who we are looking for

    Fluent and confident in English, both spoken and written.
    Preferably 3+ years of experience in hospitality, including experience in a managerial or supervisory role.
    Responsible, organized and attentive to detail.
    Follows the set procedures and makes sure that his team does so as well.
    Comfortable using computers, basic Excel and different online systems and tools.
    Confident managing, supporting and motivating a small team.
    Hands-on and willing to help with cleaning, maintenance or other practical tasks when needed.
    Positive, communicative and social, with an interest in travel, hospitality and meeting people from around the world.
    Able to work independently, take initiative and solve problems as they arise.

The role

As Hostel / Hotel Manager, you are responsible for the smooth day-to-day operation of the property. Your responsibilities include:

    Managing and overseeing a small on-site team of 1–3 people.
    Working in the hostel reception and assisting guests when needed.
    Planning staff schedules and coordinating daily tasks.
    Overseeing daily operations, supplies, linen orders and general organization.
    Ensuring that rooms and common areas meet our cleanliness and quality standards.
    Assisting with cleaning when needed.
    Handling minor maintenance and practical issues.
    Communicating and coordinating with our online reception and remote team.

The position is approximately 40–50 hours per week, working in shifts during the hostel's operating hours, with 1–2 days off per week. As manager, you have flexibility to organize your own schedule according to the needs of the property.

About us

We are a growing hospitality company operating hostels in central Stockholm, with the ambition to build an international hostel group characterized by Scandinavian design and the Nomad concept.

Our organization combines an on-site team with an online team and online reception. For the right person, there are excellent opportunities to grow with the company and take on greater responsibility as we expand.

What we offer

Salary: 30,000 SEK/month gross

Relocation: Flight to Stockholm included

Accommodation: Affordable staff accommodation available at the hostel

Vacation: One month paid vacation per year

You will work in an international environment, meet people from all over the world and have the opportunity to develop your management, hospitality and communication skills while experiencing life in Stockholm.

title: Budbilförare
description:
RT Logistik AB etablerad i 2021 och jobbar med Godstransport. Idag Vi arbetar som affärspartner med olika transport, logistik- och serviceföretag. Vi har flera år erfarenhet inom transport och Logistik. Vi jobbar med Transport av varor från terminal till Slutkund.

RT Logistik AB is a Transport Company. Transport of Goods from Terminal to end Customer is one of the major job we are doing on daily basis.

ARBETSUPPGIFTER

Som budbilschaufför är du en viktig del av vårt logistikteam och ansvarar för att leverera varor snabbt och säkert till våra kunder. Du kommer att köra en lätt lastbil eller skåpbil, planera rutter för att optimera leveranser och säkerställa att varje leverans sker i tid. Rollen kräver att du är noggrann, punktlig och har ett stort fokus på kundservice, då du är företagets ansikte utåt vid varje leverans.

Arbetsuppgifter:

Arbetet som budbilschaufför är väldigt varierande. Du levererar Pallar/paket till kunder eller företag. Du arbetar ensam och får varje dag träffa olika kunder för att ge den bästa möjliga servicen.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

As a courier driver, you are an important part of our logistics team and responsible for delivering goods quickly and safely to our customers. You will drive a light truck or van, plan routes to optimize deliveries, and ensure that each delivery is made on time. The role requires that you are accurate, punctual, and have a strong focus on customer service, as you are the company's face for every delivery.

Job duties:

The work as a courier driver is very varied. You deliver pallets/packages to customers or businesses. You work alone and meet different customers each day to provide the best possible service.

Kvalifikationer:

B-körkort.

Har god körvana.

Är flexibel med arbetstider både vardagar och helger.

Goda kunskaper i svenska eller engelska.

Vi erbjuder:

Konkurrenskraftig lön enligt kollektivavtal.

Stora möjligheter att växa både som människa och i karriären.

Ett flexibelt extrajobb med lön enligt kollektivavtal samt OB enligt Handels.

Förmåner som friskvårdsbidrag, företagshälsovård och försäkringar.

Qualifications:

B driver's license. Has good driving experience. Is flexible with working hours both weekdays and weekends.

Good knowledge of Swedish or English.

We offer:

Competitive salary according to collective agreement. Great opportunities to grow both personally and in your career.

A flexible full-time job with salary according to collective agreement and additional compensation according to Trade.

Benefits such as wellness allowance, company health care, and insurance.

title: Head of Product Data Governance
description:
How to contribute to our vision

To support growing business volumes, Siemens Energy is establishing a Product Data Governance department within the Medium Gas Turbines Product Lifecycle (MGT PLC) organization in Sweden. As Head of Product Data Management, you will set the strategic direction for product data governance, optimize Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools and processes, and build a high-performing team. Your work will strengthen data integrity, streamline engineering workflows, and enable effective cross-functional collaboration throughout the product lifecycle. You bring extensive experience in product data management, strong leadership capabilities in a technical environment, and a proven ability to manage complex engineering data structures.

What You Need to Make a Difference

    Strategic Data Governance & Framework Establishment

    Define, implement, and maintain the product data governance strategy, standards, and policies for the Medium Gas Turbines business area.
    Establish data quality metrics, ownership models, and compliance frameworks to ensure product data integrity across the entire lifecycle.
    Align product data governance initiatives with broader organizational digital transformation roadmaps and corporate standards.

    Tools, Processes & Lifecycle Management

    Lead the consolidation, optimization, and governance of product data tools, PLM systems, and associated engineering workflows to improve data quality, efficiency, and lifecycle traceability.

    Collaborate with engineering, IT, and operations to streamline data exchange, system integration, and configuration management processes.

    Establish and maintain standards for configuration control and product structure definition across relevant technical teams.

    Leadership & Capability Building

    Build, lead, and develop the newly formed Product Data Governance department, managing capacity planning and competency development.
    Promote data-driven ways of working across the Product Lifecycle organization and sister business units by establishing clear ownership, shared standards, and effective collaboration.
    Manage departmental budget, resource allocation, and stakeholder communications up to senior leadership levels.

Education

title: Legal Counsel
description:
If you are a commercially minded lawyer who wants to take ownership of complex, business-critical matters, work close to senior decision-makers as well as make an impact in a broad range of legal, strategic and business initiatives across an internationally listed company, take this unique opportunity to become our new

Legal Counsel, Corporate Legal

We are now looking for an experienced Legal Counsel to join Corporate Legal at SKF's global headquarters in Gothenburg. You will take a leading legal role in selected matters, with direct exposure to senior stakeholders and responsibility for delivering practical solutions on some of SKF's most strategic and business-critical initiatives.

What we and the role offers:

Corporate Legal is part of SKF's lean corporate center and the wider Group Legal & Compliance function. We are a small, strong and business-centric team supporting SKF's leadership and key stakeholders in the central group functions. Our mandate covers matters of strategic importance, significant legal or commercial risk and a broad range of operational legal questions. Working at the intersection of law, business, technology and corporate governance, you will gain direct insight into key decisions and the opportunity to influence how complex matters are structured and executed across a large international corporation. The role has a distinctly global reach, offering frequent opportunities to work alongside legal colleagues, business leaders and specialists across SKF's worldwide organisation.

Our work spans many of the legal areas that support SKF's business and long-term development, including strategic projects and collaborations, M&A, governance, commercial contracting, IT, innovation and technology development, litigation and claims management, corporate finance, marketing and media.



What you can expect in the role:

    Independently manage your matters from initial assessment through drafting, negotiation, decision and implementation, while knowing when to involve colleagues or external counsel
    Form a clear legal view, recommend a course of action and help stakeholders move from analysis to decision and implementation
    Advise senior stakeholders across Finance, Treasury, Investor Relations, Sustainability, IT, Supply Chain, Communications, People Experience (HR) and other group functions.
    Draft, negotiate and review a wide range of agreements
    Support M&A, strategic projects, governance, commercial contracts, technology and innovation initiatives
    Manage litigation and claims-related matters
    Provide pragmatic, business-focused legal advice and risk management support
    Collaborate with legal colleagues and business leaders across SKF's global organization, giving you the opportunity to build an international network and contribute across jurisdictions while helping stakeholders meet business objectives and manage legal risk.



What makes this role particularly unique is the combination of autonomy and breadth of the Corporate Legal mandate. Few in-house legal positions at large international companies offer exposure to such a wide range of matters together with genuine responsibility for shaping solutions. You can remain a broad corporate lawyer while building a recognized area of expertise in the fields that genuinely interest you and that align with our business. We think lawyers perform at their best when they pair a wide view of the business with deeper knowledge in the areas that interest them most. As a result, the exact shape of the role will develop over time depending on your experience, interests and strengths, as well as the needs of the business.

We expect you to have/be:

    Master's degree in law (LLM).
    Extensive relevant experience from a well-renowned law firm, an international company or a combination of both.
    Comfortable in leading discussions and challenging constructively and making progress when the path is not yet fully defined.
    Establish credibility with senior stakeholders through effective communication, integrity, engagement and turn legal analysis into practical options.
    Analytically skilled with the ability to approach complex issues with commercial curiosity, integrity and a can-do attitude.
    Experience in commercial contracts or transactions is valuable.
    Enjoy variety and are comfortable switching between high-level strategic discussions and detailed legal analysis.
    Eager to continue to learn and develop across an evolving legal landscape.
    Collaborative and confident working across cultures and functions
    Proficiency in both verbal communication and presentations in English. Swedish is desirable, and so is other languages.

What you'll love about SKF...

*A culture of diversity and inclusion!

SKF is committed to creating a diverse environment, and we firmly believe that a diverse workforce is essential for our continued success. Therefore, we only focus on your experience, skills, and potential. Come as you are – just be yourself #weareSKF

*Fair and transparent compensation!

We provide transparent salary information in line with local legislation and base our decisions on objective criteria to ensure fairness and consistency throughout the recruitment process.



Some additional information

This position is located in Gothenburg, Sweden, on a local contract.

You will report to the Director Corporate Legal, who is located in Gothenburg, Sweden. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Pernilla Book by phone/Teams/email.

For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Katrin Edelmann, Talent Acquisition Partner Europe & Africa who is located in Schweinfurt, Germany at katrin.edelmann@skf.com. Please note that we can't accept applications via email.

Is this you?

If the answer is yes, submit your application in English no later than 19th October 2026. Please note that we can't accept applications via email.

title: Electronic Hardware Design Engineer
description:
Company description:

AVL is one of the world’s leading mobility technology companies for development, simulation and testing in the automotive industry, and beyond. The company provides concepts, solutions and methodologies in fields like vehicle development and integration, e-mobility, automated and connected mobility (ADAS/AD), and software for a greener, safer, better world of mobility.

Job description:

As an Electronic Hardware Design Engineer, you will play a key role in developing innovative solutions within the rapidly evolving field of automotive electronics. We are looking for a driven individual who is motivated to continuously broaden their expertise in electronic hardware, contributing both at customer sites and to the development of our in-house capabilities. The position is part of our Hardware and Systems Development team, based in Gothenburg, Sweden.

AVL takes part in a wide range of projects within Vehicle, Hybrid and Electromobility in the automotive industry. AVL MTC has approximately 200 employees based in Gothenburg, Stockholm, Haninge and Södertälje. As an engineer at AVL you will work with cutting edge technology in collaboration with experts in the global AVL team and our successful customers. You will be working close to our local customers in Gothenburg area within the AVL facilities or as Resident Engineer at customers in Sweden.


    As an Electronics Hardware Design Engineer, you will be responsible for specification, development, commissioning and validation of power inverter HW system and its subsystems (e.g. control board, power supply, gate driver board and power modules)
    Define and develop requirements, design as well as Architectures for new and existing Hardware concepts in the area of Power inverter controls, DC-DC converter controls, Zone Controller, Body controller, Battery management system and Driver assistance systems
    Create product specific and complex controls electronics while balancing constraints in space, EMI/EMC, cost and manufacturability
    Responsible for definition of detailed verification tests for the newly developed electronics. Support the actual testing and troubleshooting effort to ensure success of the newly developed designs
    Create new designs and concepts within standard automotive development process
    Good system understanding to translate requirements of hardware coming from electronics designers and software coming from the software development teams  
    Ability to work in an agile manner while operating in international teams
    Interaction and communication on technical topics with engineering teams of international customer base  

Profile description:


    Degree in Electronics/Electrical/Mechatronic engineering with relevant work experience in Electronics and Mechatronics  
    6-8 years automotive demonstrable experience in development of Embedded Hardware and Power Electronics  
    Good knowledge of handling EMC/EMI requirements, trouble shooting and engineering methods to maintain compliance
    Multiple years of experience in schematic and layout design in Altium designer and electronics simulation in LTspice.
    Knowledge of Automotive domain i.e. Design Standards and design processes  

Personal attributes:


    Excellent communication and presentation skills in English including on-site presentations at customers. Swedish is meritorious.
    Ability to adapt to customer cultures and create new opportunities to grow local expertise within the field of Electromobility.
    Self-directed, systematic, and structured approach to work.
    Teamplayer with ability to get along with a diverse set of team members
    High level of integrity and responsibility.
    B category Driving license.

We offer:


    Be part of our pioneering work– together with our customers we shape the future of mobility!
    Competitive compensation packages
    Collective Agreement and insurances
    Working with international OEMs
    International and innovative collaborations

Interested?

In this recruitment process, we apply continuous selection. The process may move quickly, and the position may be filled before the final application deadline.

title: Flexible administrative support opportunity at SSE (Hourly, up to 20%)
description:
The Education Office (EdO) is one of SSE’s Professional Services units and consists of around 58 colleagues. As a central part of the SSE journey, we support and develop key academic services for students and stakeholders across our BSc, MSc, and PhD programs. Our work spans assessment, program management, scholarships, international collaborations, academic support, central course and exam coordination, as well as degrees and certificates.

Would you like to work in a dynamic international environment and contribute to the day-to-day operations of one of Europe's leading business schools?

The Education Office at the Stockholm School of Economics (SSE) is building a small pool of flexible hourly staff who can provide support during peak periods and special projects throughout the year.

As part of our support pool, you will step in where extra resources are needed most. Assignments vary over time and may involve administrative support related to admissions, student exchange, student services, events, information services, communication, and other Education Office activities.

    Assist with exchange and international mobility activities
    Support the Info Center and student-facing services
    Help coordinate events, welcome activities, and visits
    Assist with data entry, reporting, and quality assurance
    Support communication and information updates
    Contribute to project-based administrative tasks across the Education Office

    Structured, accurate, and detail-oriented
    Service-minded and professional in interactions with students, faculty, staff, and visitors
    Flexible and comfortable handling different types of assignments
    Reliable and able to work independently
    Comfortable working in digital systems and administrative processes
    Fluent in English, both spoken and written
    Able to communicate in Swedish, as some assignments require interaction with Swedish-speaking stakeholders and documentation
    Comfortable handling information with discretion and confidentiality

    Experience from multiple areas of higher education administration
    The opportunity to work with colleagues across the Education Office
    A welcoming and international work environment
    Flexible scheduling based on operational needs and your availability

title: Regional Security Director - North Europe
description:
Company description:

We are a global, diverse, inclusive security team unified by a common purpose and a pragmatic can-do attitude. As our people are core to our business, we aim to maintain an excellent work-life balance within the team.

Our service offering and expertise incorporate the following disciplines: Crisis Management, Fire Safety, Investigations, Information -, Product -, Physical -, People -, and Travel Security.  





Job description:





Are you a pragmatic and innovative security leader? Do you have a proven track record of successfully delivering security programs and operating in diverse and challenging environments? Are you a self-starter?  





Then join our team





As part of our regional team, you will be responsible for building and maintaining effective and trusted relationships with key internal and external stakeholders and providing innovative and business-orientated solutions to complex security challenges.

  



Stakeholders should recognize your role as the “can-do” subject matter expert, advisor, security auditor, responder, and trainer within their region.

Key Regional Responsibilities and Scope



The main areas of regional responsibility are Security Risk Management, Crisis Management, Physical Security, People Security, Product Security, Travel Security, Information Security and Investigations. These include the oversight of regional security governance and assurance activities.  



The main job tasks include, but are not limited to:





Contribute to developing and delivering the Global Security Strategy, Group Security programs, objectives, and priorities.



Support the development of security governance and manage the implementation and continuous refinement of security policies, standards, guidelines, instructions, requirements, and procedures.  



Provide expertise on regional security issues to senior regional and site management.



Develop and maintain security awareness programs, deliver related training to employees, and travel across the region to support security operations and awareness initiatives



Respond to requests and questions from across the business and line management for advice and assistance.



Conduct and support security risk assessments.  



Conduct site security audits to identify best practices and gaps. Support findings by providing suitable solutions to mitigate the risks.



Develop crisis training material and train local crisis response teams with support from the Head Office.



Provide accurate information and effective response to business travellers who are experiencing an incident or crisis.



Conduct Security investigations of counterfeit, illegal diversion and product theft cases and background investigations.



Maintain collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to gather intelligence to identify and evaluate threats, vulnerabilities, and associated risks to the Volvo Group.



Collaborate with other Volvo units globally to efficiently develop and deliver services and products with the best applicable quality, delivery time and cost within an agreed budget.



Establish and maintain regional relationships with security practitioners in other commercial sectors, intelligence networks, law enforcement and related government/intelligence agencies.



As a Volvo Regional Security Director you will:

Contribute to the overall development of strategic goals, performance metrics,     communication practices and culture.



Create and maintain effective partnerships with our internal Cybersecurity, IT Security, Group Security, Group Compliance, Group Audit, Group Legal and People and Culture management teams to ensure alignment, where applicable.



Build effective partnerships with business unit management whilst ensuring accountability and professionalism.



Build and nurture external networks of industry peers, ecosystem partners, vendors, and other relevant parties to address common trends, findings, incidents, and risks.



Be a respected Group Security Ambassador who aligns with the Volvo Groups’ values and principles

The Volvo Group, one of the global leaders in sustainable transport solutions, is looking for an experienced senior security leader with proven experience in protective security to drive a pragmatic security program and culture protecting Volvo Group’s people, information, products, and assets.

title: Senior Process Specialist - Additive Manufacturing
description:
Innovation starts with curiosity. Meaningful progress starts with execution.

Join SKF! We are looking for a

Senior Process Specialist – Additive Manufacturing Laser Powder Bed Fusion (L-PBF)

As a Senior Process Specialist within Additive Manufacturing, you will play a key role in developing, qualifying, and industrializing Laser Powder Bed Fusion (L-PBF) processes for metallic materials and applications. The primary focus of the role is to bridge technology development with product and manufacturing implementation, ensuring robust, scalable and cost-effective additive manufacturing solutions that support SKF's growth ambitions.

You will act as a technical expert in additive manufacturing, driving process qualification, manufacturing readiness, product introduction and continuous process improvement. In your daily work you will work closely with product development, manufacturing, quality and researchers to support additive manufacturing in large.

Your Day-to-day work/ Key Responsibilities:

    Manage process development activities related to the L-PBF process with a clear focus on process qualification in close collaboration with product development.
    Develop and implement methodologies for process verification and quality assurance, e.g. by utilizing advanced process monitoring and quality assurance software for in-process control and defect detection.
    Contribute to the advancement of additive manufacturing capabilities and technologies within SKF. Specific focus will be on running Proof-of-Concept activities with related prototype development.
    Stay up to date on technical development and know-how with respect to additive manufacturing, and to make sure this knowledge is spread within the organization.

We expect you to have/be:

    Master's degree (or higher) in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering or similar with minimum 5 years of hands-on industrial experience with L-PBF technology and metal additive manufacturing. PhD in Additive Manufacturing and Materials Science, or related field, will be considered an advantage.
    Demonstrated experience in taking additive manufacturing processes and applications from development into industrial implementation, including process qualification, production readiness, and cross-functional product realization activities.
    In-depth practical experience and a deep understanding of the L-PBF machine and related operation, calibration, troubleshooting, and process development, where optimization for medium- and high carbon steels will be considered an advantage.
    Experience from process monitoring and quality assurance software used in additive manufacturing.
    Proficiency in CAD and design tools relevant to additive manufacturing, where experience in Design for Additive Manufacturing (DfAM) will be considered an advantage.
    Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

You will enjoy working here if you:

    Have a curious mindset and a passion for technology development and innovation.
    Have sound analytical and problem-solving skills and a structured and data-driven approach to engineering challenges.
    Thrive from working with skilled colleagues from across disciplines with capabilities covering the full manufacturing process chain.



What you'll love about SKF...

*A culture of diversity and inclusion!

SKF is committed to creating a diverse environment, and we firmly believe that a diverse workforce is essential for our continued success. Therefore, we only focus on your experience, skills, and potential. Come as you are – just be yourself #weareSKF

*Fair and transparent compensation!

We provide transparent salary information in line with local legislation and base our decisions on objective criteria to ensure fairness and consistency throughout the recruitment process.

Some additional information

This position is located in Gothenburg, Sweden, on a local contract.

You will report to the Manager, Steel, Heat Treatment & NDT and Principal Engineer, Manufacturing Technology, who is located in Gothenburg, Sweden. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Kristina Ryttberg by phone/Teams/email.

For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Katrin Edelmann, Talent Acquisition Partner Europe & Africa who is located in Schweinfurt, Germany at katrin.edelmann@skf.com. Please note that we can't accept applications via email.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of next-generation powertrain control systems. You will work in a high-performing in-house team of skilled engineers to develop advanced powertrain solutions, ranging from hybrid engine control systems to fully electric powertrains, including electric drive units and inverters.

We are looking for a development engineer who can understand customer requirements, identify efficient solutions in collaboration with suppliers and colleagues, and contribute to the design of technical solutions. The role offers challenging engineering assignments that support both technical and professional development. You will be responsible for the software of one or more ECUs or inverters within ongoing development projects.

The company offers opportunities for collaborative professionals who want to make a difference. The focus is on developing sustainable mobility solutions, reducing environmental impact, and designing innovative powertrain technologies for the automotive industry and beyond.

The organization values collaboration, a global mindset, innovation, and a commitment to engineering excellence.

What will you do?

As a Software Responsible, you will act as the component owner for software within your assigned project. You will lead software deliverables towards suppliers and customers and coordinate the development of base software for ECUs or inverters throughout different project phases.

You will work closely with software and hardware engineers within a cross-functional project team, collaborating with project leadership and base technology architects.

You will serve as the primary point of contact for the supplier regarding your assigned product and ensure that technical performance, cost, and delivery timing meet project objectives.

title: PhD student in agricultural bioeconomy systems
description:
Department of Biosystems and Technology

PhD project: Sustainable utilisation of agricultural green biomass in integrated protein and biogas systems

Subject area: Technology

Description of the doctoral project



A circular and fossil-independent bioeconomy requires renewable biomass without increasing competition for agricultural land and food production. Crop residues and intermediate crops are therefore particularly relevant resources. Research at SLU shows that these biomass resources can be substantial, but their potential and sustainable utilisation vary regionally. They can be used for biogas, while effects on soil carbon and nutrient cycling need to be considered.  

Green biomass can also be biorefined into plant protein for feed or food, after which the remaining streams are used for biogas. The same feedstock can thereby provide protein, energy and recycled nutrients.

The project aims to assess the potential and consequences of large-scale utilisation of green crop residues and intermediate crops in integrated biogas and green biorefinery systems.

The project will:

    assess sustainably available biomass from green crop residues and intermediate crops in Sweden;
    assess the potential for biogas and combined plant protein and biogas production;
    develop implementation scenarios based on feedstock availability, infrastructure, logistics and markets;
    assess effects on nutrient cycling, soil carbon, biomethane, fertilizer use, and feed and food production; and
    evaluate economic and wider socio-economic benefits, drawbacks and trade-offs.

The project combines GIS and agricultural data with mass and nutrient balances, scenario modelling, and life cycle-based, techno-economic and socio-economic methods. Data will be drawn from research, statistics, literature and national databases.

The doctoral student will join an interdisciplinary research environment at SLU Alnarp focusing on sustainable agricultural production, bioenergy, circular bioeconomy and systems analysis.

About the position

The work includes collection and processing of agricultural and process data, GIS, modelling of biomass and product flows, scenario development, and environmental and economic assessments.  

You will integrate information from crop production and biomass availability to biorefineries, biogas, and food and energy systems.  

You will analyse data, develop models and scenarios, and publish and present research results. The work will be conducted with researchers at SLU and external partners.  

The doctoral student will be part of the Biogas Solutions Research Center (BSRC), a national transdisciplinary centre where Linköping University, SLU and around 50 private and public organisations collaborate. The centre is supported by the Swedish Energy Agency. The PhD project follows BSRC’s research plans and contributes to long-term competence development in industry and academia.

Requirements

To meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).

Specific entry requirements for the third-cycle courses and study programme in technology. To meet the specific entry requirements, you must have the equivalent knowledge to a minimum of 90 credits in relevant subject areas. This must include a degree project, and at least 30 credits must be at the advanced level.  

You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.

You should have a Master’s degree or equivalent in, for example, biosystems/agricultural engineering, environmental engineering, agricultural science, energy systems, industrial ecology, environmental science or a related field.

Your profile

We are looking for a motivated candidate interested in sustainable agricultural and bioeconomy systems and quantitative analysis.

Experience or documented knowledge in one or several of the following areas is desirable:

    systems analysis, modelling or scenario analysis;
    GIS and spatial analysis;
    life cycle assessment, environmental systems analysis or material-flow analysis;
    techno-economic or socio-economic assessment;
    bioenergy, biogas or biorefinery systems;
    agricultural production systems and agricultural biomass;
    statistical analysis and handling of larger datasets;
    experience of programming or quantitative modelling, for example using Python, R or MATLAB.

You should have good analytical skills, be able to integrate information from different fields, work independently and collaborate well.

Excellent written and spoken English is required. Good communication skills are important. Knowledge of Swedish is advantageous but not required.

Personal qualities, motivation and the ability to successfully complete doctoral studies will be given considerable weight.

About us

The Department of Biosystems and Technology develops knowledge for sustainable and resource-efficient agriculture, horticulture and bioeconomy through research combining biological production systems, technology and systems analysis.

The project lies at the intersection of agriculture, biosystems engineering, sustainability assessment and bioeconomy.

Read more about third-cycle courses and study programmes on http://www.slu.se/utbildning/program-kurser/forskarutbildning/

Form of employment / Funding

Employment as a doctoral student (4-year programme)

Doctoral student’s salaries are set following the local collective agreement. Salary progression is fixed.

Location:

Alnarp, Sweden

100%

Start date:

Upon agreement. A start date in January or February 2027 is preferred.



Application and selection:

YOU ARE

At OX2, you will have the opportunity to influence how cybersecurity is managed across an international portfolio of renewable energy assets. title: Associate professor in Environmental and Energy Systems Analysis
description:
Join Chalmers and help shape the future of sustainable maritime transport through internationally leading research with real-world impact. This position offers the opportunity to build and lead your own research agenda in a dynamic, collaborative environment at the forefront of the energy and environmental transition.

Chalmers University of Technology strives for academic excellence while also addressing the challenges and needs of society and industry. We offer a creative and dynamic environment for research, education, innovation and applied science. We aim to become a globally leading university of technology, with a strong emphasis on high-quality research and education, openness and collaboration.

At the recently formed https://www.chalmers.se/en/departments/env/ we identify, analyse and describe the major environmental challenges of our time, with the aim of developing models, tools and competitive technological solutions to support the transition in sectors such as energy, transport and heavy industry. A significant part of our research takes a systems perspective, focusing on the interaction between technology, society and the environment in order to develop resilient solutions for the future.

As part of the formation of our new department, we invite applications for a position as associate professor, focusing on environmental and energy systems analysis, in the area of maritime transport.

About the role

The associate professor is expected to lead, advance, and develop research in the area of maritime transport. Particular emphasis will be placed on research assessing the environmental impacts of shipping. Teaching responsibilities include close collaboration with Chalmers school of Maritime studies, and development of courses, primarily at master's and doctoral level, connected to the research area. Utilization of research results is an important part of the role, and the associate professor is expected to interact with both public and private stakeholders.

The appointment as Associate Professor is a permanent faculty position.

About the division and department

The Department of Environmental and Energy Sciences consists of five research divisions, with the common goal of providing excellent research that can enable solutions for transition to a sustainable society. The department offers a dynamic and inspiring academic environment, and well-developed networks with industry and relevant public stakeholders at national, international and global levels. The Maritime Environmental Science Division, with about 20 employees, strives to be a key player that provides science for the development of a sustainable transport sector with focus on maritime transport. We contribute by producing new knowledge through a combination of modelling and experimental work, and the development of new technology and decision support.

Your responsibilities

The position includes conducting and advancing research, education, and collaboration in close cooperation with colleagues across the department and university. In this role, you will be expected to:

    Conduct and lead research as an independent Principal Investigator at a high international standard.
    Contribute to teaching at all levels in collaboration with other faculty members.
    Continuously develop your pedagogical skills and actively contribute to the development of courses and educational programmes.
    Foster a vibrant academic culture and participate in departmental and university-wide activities.
    Supervise undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral students.
    Apply for external research funding to further strengthen and advance your research programme.
    Contribute to the development of your discipline both nationally and internationally.
    Actively support the dissemination and utilization of research results and contribute to academic citizenship.

Qualifications and merits

To qualify for the Associate Professor position, you have a doctoral degree in a relevant field and demonstrate independent scientific research of a high international quality and growing production of research.

You have:

    Performed research that has resulted in publications and presentations in relevant and respected venues for your field
    Demonstrated ability to acquire research funding
    Demonstrated ability to establish national and international collaborations.
    Supervised doctoral students as main and/or assistant supervisor
    Higher Education pedagogical training in accordance with the current SUHF recommendation (preferable)
    Teaching experience, including course development
    Well established national and international networks within the subject area
    Documented utilization of your research results in relevant societal fora
    Contributed to a good working environment in your current and former workplaces
    Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, in English

title: R&D Engineer
description:
R&D Engineer (Battery Characterization)

Are you someone who speaks "Electrochemistry" as a second language? Do you find the perfect charge-discharge curve more satisfying than a morning coffee? If you are a lab-savvy engineer who bridges the gap between deep science and industrial reality, we want to talk to you.

The Role:

We are looking for an R&D Engineer to join our team and take the lead on in-depth and functional battery characterizations. This isn't just about running tests; it's about understanding the "consensus" behind the data. You will be the bridge between our synthesis lab and our final performance targets, providing critical feedback to optimize materials and refine our processes.

Required Expertise:

o  Proven laboratory experience with a focus on battery technologies. A degree with focus in electrochemistry and battery related materials synthesis is a merit.



o  A strong grasp of electrochemical characterization techniques and fundamentals.



o  Excellent communication skills, and can explain your results to colleagues and stakeholders with equal clarity.



o  A collaborative spirit; you enjoy giving (and receiving) constructive feedback to improve material performance.



o  You have walked in both worlds: prior experience in both academic research and industrial environments.



o  You are a natural organizer with experience in project coordination.



o  You have a track record of presenting at conferences or to external partners.

About Granode Materials:

Granode develops a disruptive technology in development of the silicon graphite composites, using widely available/cheap metallurgical micro-silicon without the use of hazardous gases such as silane etc. Granode’s anode composite promotes a drop-in solution compatible with conventional battery making technology with verified electrochemical performance over the battery life-cycle. As usage of the lithium-ion batteries (LiBs) multiplies, the specific requirements for higher energy density of the operating devices such as electric vehicles and the unmanned aviation is becoming more pronounced. Whilst the market for LiBs is experiencing drastic growth (27% per annum), the issues regarding sufficient energy density, availability of the raw materials and high costs are indeed critical drags for wide implementation and sustainable growth of such industry mainly in Europe. The unique anode technology developed at Granode offers significant improvement in the capacity and energy density of the LiBs compared to conventional graphite. In addition, it provides a sustainable and cheap platform for domestic supply chain of anodes.  

How to apply:

Please email your (1) CVs with title ’’ R&D Engineer’’ to address info@granode.com . There is no need for cover letter, (2) just write paragraph about your battery research/background and some of your problem-solving skills at previous relevant experiences.

title: Senior C++ Systems Developer - Live Media
description:
OFFER

When live video travels across networks, every part of the system needs to deliver. At Net Insight, you will work on the software that makes reliable media transport possible — solving demanding engineering problems together with experienced colleagues who enjoy sharing their knowledge.

We are looking for a senior C++ developer to join the Nimbra Edge team. This is a hands-on role with substantial technical ownership, where you will improve performance, investigate complex problems and influence the architecture behind a product used in professional media delivery.

Some of the reasons to join Net Insight:

    

Technically challenging work in modern C++23, close to Linux, networking and hardware.

    

The opportunity to influence architecture, implementation and development practices.

    

A small, autonomous team within an established international technology company.

    

Friendly, knowledgeable colleagues who value collaboration and open discussion.

    

Flexible working hours and a workplace that understands life outside work.



THE PRODUCT AND TEAM

Nimbra Edge enables the transport of live video across internet and private networks. You will join the team responsible for its dataplane: the C++ software that handles the actual flow of media through the system.

The dataplane team consists of four engineers and works closely with seven colleagues developing the cloud parts of the product. Together, they cover a broad technical scope, from cloud software to the systems interacting with the underlying hardware.

It is a friendly, collaborative group where you can discuss a difficult problem, challenge an idea and ask for another perspective. You will have room to work independently, with colleagues who support one another and care about the quality of the result.



THE ROLE

A central part of your work will be getting more from the available hardware: increasing channel capacity, reducing resource consumption and maintaining predictable performance under demanding conditions.

You will move between architectural decisions and detailed investigation, following a problem through the stack to understand its root cause. That might mean examining memory access and concurrency, analysing network traffic or investigating how Linux scheduling affects latency.

Your work will include:

    

Developing and improving performance-critical software in modern C++.

    

Profiling and optimising CPU, memory and network resource usage.

    

Investigating difficult bugs across software, operating system and hardware interactions.

    

Making architectural decisions and building solutions that remain clear and maintainable.

    

Reviewing code and sharing technical knowledge within the team.

    

Testing and validating behaviour on real hardware in the lab.

The current focus includes high-performance packet processing with DPDK and uncompressed video and audio transport using SMPTE ST 2110. You will also encounter precision timing, Linux tuning and hardware-accelerated media processing.

You can learn ST 2110 and DPDK here. What you bring is the systems knowledge and engineering judgement needed to understand challenging problems and work through them.

YOUR PROFILE

You are an experienced developer who still enjoys being deeply involved in the code. You take initiative when the next step is unclear, investigate before drawing conclusions and look for solutions that keep the system as simple as possible.

You also enjoy working with others. You explain your reasoning, listen to different perspectives and share what you learn. Your technical contribution includes helping the team reach sound decisions together.

We are looking for:

    

10+ years of professional software development experience.

    

Deep knowledge of modern C++ and systems programming, including memory management, concurrency and performance profiling.

    

Strong Linux experience, including troubleshooting involving the operating system, scheduling or hardware.

    

Solid networking fundamentals and confidence analysing traffic and protocol behaviour at packet level.

    

Experience developing performance-critical or real-time software with demanding latency, jitter or throughput requirements.

    

The ability to take ownership of technical problems and make well-founded design decisions.

Experience with video streaming protocols and media transport is particularly valuable. Other relevant experience includes DPDK or XDP, precision time synchronisation, NICs and drivers, or hardware-accelerated media processing.

Your background may be in media technology, telecom, networking or another field with demanding systems and performance requirements. Previous broadcast experience is welcome, but is not required.

The team also uses AI tools in its development workflow, and welcomes curiosity about how they can support your work.

LOCATION Net Insight develops technology for professional media networks, helping broadcasters, service providers and media organisations transport live content reliably. Its engineering work spans hardware, networking and cloud software, bringing together specialists across several technical disciplines.

For more info, visit https://netinsight.net/

This recruitment is direct employment at Net Insight AB and all applications, questions, administration, and recruitment processes are managed by Pinetree AB.

I rollen ansvarar du för att skapa en välfungerande vardag för våra kunder och samtidigt driva affären framåt. Du arbetar både operativt och relationsskapande, med tydligt fokus på service, uthyrning och resultat.

Bearbeta leads, genomföra visningar och driva uthyrningsprocessen från första kontakt till tecknat avtal

Är kommunikativ, lyhörd och tydlig i samarbetet med såväl kunder som kollegor

La Clinique de La Source est un établissement de soins aigus pluridisciplinaires unique en son genre. Un membre de notre équipe poursuit aujourd’hui un nouveau projet de formation professionnel. Pour assurer la continuité d’une prise en charge d’excellence en soins intensifs, nous souhaitons accueillir un·e infirmier·ère certifié·e expert·e en soins intensifs EPD ES.

Réaliser les soins infirmiers et les actes médicaux délégués avec rigueur, en garantissant leur qualité, leur sécurité et leur traçabilité

Collaborer et coordonner les soins avec l’ensemble des professionnel·les impliqué·es dans la prise en charge

L’équipe des soins intensifs, composée d'une vingtaine de soignant·es, cultive un environnement de travail technique mais serein. Il est en constante recherche de nouvelles solutions de développement et de progression.

Etre titulaire d'un diplôme d’expert·e en soins intensifs EPD ES reconnu par la Société Suisse de Médecine Intensive (SGI\-SSMI)  
Avoir une expérience d’au moins trois ans en soins intensifs ou réanimation

Posséder une aisance dans les transmissions et une excellente capacité de communication avec une expression claire et adaptée aux situations  
Vos atouts :  
Expérience et polyvalence dans différentes disciplines médicales et chirurgicales  
Sens des responsabilités et faire preuve de dynamisme, rigueur, anticipation, précision, autonomie et loyauté  
Compétences scientifiques, techniques et humaines permettant de travailler dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire  
Pourquoi choisir la Clinique de La Source ?

Concilier vie professionnelle et vie privée, grâce à des possibilités de travail à temps partiel, jusqu’à plus de 7 semaines de vacances, des congés non payés, des jours fériés compensés et la valorisation du temps de change

You work closely with the Communications Department to organize customer events for your store

Notre client est un bureau d'ingénieurs établi en Suisse, intervenant sur des projets variés dans les domaines du bâtiment, des infrastructures et des ouvrages techniques. **Votre rôle**

En tant que Chef·fe de Projet, vous prenez la responsabilité de mandats de structures depuis les premières phases d'étude jusqu'à la réalisation des ouvrages.

Vous intervenez comme interlocuteur privilégié des maîtres d'ouvrage, architectes et partenaires du projet. À ce titre, vous coordonnez les différents intervenants, assurez le suivi technique et financier des affaires et veillez au respect des objectifs de qualité, de coûts et de délais.

Votre expertise vous permet d'apporter une réelle valeur ajoutée dans les choix techniques et les orientations constructives, tout en garantissant la faisabilité et la cohérence globale des projets.

Vous pilotez les études de conception et participez activement au développement des solutions techniques les plus adaptées aux contraintes des projets.

Vous supervisez les calculs, les modélisations et la production des documents techniques nécessaires à l'exécution des ouvrages.

Vous accompagnez les clients et partenaires tout au long du projet, en leur apportant des conseils techniques pertinents et une vision claire des enjeux.

Vous participez aux séances de coordination et assurez le suivi des travaux afin de garantir la conformité des réalisations aux exigences définies.

Enfin, vous contribuez au développement du bureau par la qualité de vos réalisations et la confiance que vous instaurez avec vos interlocuteurs.

title: Lead Solution Architect & Consultant
description:
Lead Solution Architect \& Consultant (m/w/d)  
Was du bei uns bewegen kannst  
Pionierarbeit \& Standortscheduling: Als technische Speerspitze gestaltest du das Wachstum von inovex in der Schweiz aktiv mit. Du verbindest technologische Glaubwürdigkeit im Pre\-Sales mit nachhaltiger Projektdelivery und legst das solide Fundament, auf dem zukünftige Teams aufbauen.  
Brücke zwischen Business\-Vision \& Code: Du schliesst die Lücke zwischen Business\-Bedürfnissen und Technologie. Vage Kundenideen und komplexe Anforderungen übersetzt du treffsicher in konkrete und funktionierende Softwarelösungen.  
Hands\-on Prototyping \& Software Engineering: Der Schwerpunkt deiner Rolle liegt in der aktiven Umsetzung moderner Softwarelösungen und Systemarchitekturen direkt im Kundenprojekt. Mit hoher Geschwindigkeit baust du funktionale Prototypen sowie MVPs auf.  
Pre\-Sales \& Strategische Beratung: Du führst und/oder begleitest Kundengespräche und übersetzt Business\-Visionen in pragmatische, machbare Softwarekonzepte. Du führst interaktive Discovery\- sowie Architektur\-Workshops durch und lieferst fundierte Aufwandsschätzungen.  
Architektur\-Standards \& Agile Führung: Für unsere Projekte definierst du technische Standards sowie strukturierte Konzepte für komplexe IT\-Landschaften. Deine Projekte steuerst du nach agilen Methoden – idealerweise untermauert durch Zertifizierungen wie Professional Scrum Developer oder Scrum Master.  
Wer gut zu uns passen würde  
In der Rolle als Solution IT Architect \& Consultant liegt dein Schwerpunkt klar auf der strategischen Beratung, der vorausschauenden Konzeption und dem Aufsetzen moderner Architekturmuster – weniger auf der reinen operativen Umsetzung. Du begleitest Entscheidungsträger auf Augenhöhe, bewertest neue Technologien und legst das Fundament für zukunftsfähige Softwarelösungen. Dazu bringst du Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse aus den folgenden Bereichen mit:  
Fullstack\-Engineering \& Architektur\-Expertise: Du blickst auf mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung komplexer Software\-Architekturen zurück. Dein Tech\-Stack umfasst moderne Frontend\- und Backend\-Technologien (z. B. TypeScript, Kotlin / Boot oder .NET / C\#) sowie Containerisierung (Docker, Kubernetes) und CI/CD\-Pipelines.  
Cloud\-Native \& Modern Tooling: Praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud\-Infrastrukturen (bevorzugt AWS oder Azure) ist für dich selbstverständlich. Du entscheidest, wann Serverless\- oder Hybrid\-Cloud\-Szenarien sinnvoll sind.  
Data \& AI Grundlagen: Ein solides Verständnis moderner Datenplattformen und Data Engineering rundet dein Profil ab, sodass du Kunden auch bei datengetriebenen Architekturen ganzheitlich beraten kannst.  
Beratungspersönlichkeit \& Unternehmergeist: Das Schliessen der Lücke zwischen Business\-Bedürfnissen und Code treibt dich an. Du denkst unternehmerisch, überzeugst Stakeholder durch fachliche Exzellenz sowie Empathie und schätzt die Abwechslung zwischen strategischem Consulting und konkretem Coding.  
Sprachkompetenz \& Reisetätigkeit: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind Voraussetzung (mind. Level C1\), gute Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab. ösischkenntnisse sehen wir als zusätzliche Ergänzung. Eine projektbezogene Reisebereitschaft (hauptsächlich innerhalb der Schweiz, gelegentlich nach Deutschland) ist für dich kein Problem.  
Dein Team  
In Bern bauen wir gemeinsam das inovex\-Team auf. Dabei geht es nicht um die Mitarbeit in einem bestehenden Team, sondern um die aktive Mitgestaltung des Markteintritts und der Positionierung von inovex in der Schweiz. Du arbeitest in einem kleinen, hochqualifizierten Kernteam, das den Anspruch hat, inovex im Markt nachhaltig zu etablieren – in enger Abstimmung und Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kolleg:innen in Deutschland. Dabei verbinden wir die Erfahrung, Methoden und technologische Exzellenz eines etablierten Unternehmens mit unternehmerischem Gestaltungsspielraum vor Ort. Unsere Konzepte implementieren wir bevorzugt mit Open Source Software im Rahmen agiler Projekte. Die meisten der von uns entwickelten Lösungen integrieren wir in bestehende IT\-Systeme, weshalb wir von Beginn unserer Projekte an auf integrierte Qualitätssicherung setzen. Bei uns verläuft kein Projekt wie das andere – je nach Kunde, Team und Technologie\-Stack ist jede Lösung einzigartig. Unser Fokus ist jedoch immer derselbe: Mit innovativen Technologien und einem hohen Anspruch an die Sicherheit, Wartbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme wollen wir nicht nur unsere Kunden glücklich machen, sondern auch uns selbst.

Gipf-Oberfrick liegt im malerischen Fricktal des Kantons Aargau und besticht durch seine Nähe zur Natur sowie die gute Verkehrsanbindung via Bahn und Straße. Sie profitieren hier von einer ruhigen, ländlichen Umgebung mit kurzen Wegen zu regionalen Wirtschaftszentren. Die Region bietet Ihnen als Arbeitsort eine ausgezeichnete Lebensqualität, kombiniert mit wirtschaftlichen Chancen in einem dynamisch wachsenden Landstrich.

### Ihre Aufgaben als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Stv. Stationsleitung in Gipf-Oberfrick

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Diese Qualifikationen bringen Sie mit

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Stv. Stationsleitung

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.
